title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Application deadline

November 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Interviews

Interviews are expected to take place in early December 2026.

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Hospitalsringen 90, 5260 Odense S.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Tööülesanded: Autode hooldus- ja remonttööde teostamine.Peamised tööülesanded: - Sõiduautode ja maasturite hooldus ning remont. - Veermiku, pidurisüsteemide ja jõuülekande remont. - Mootorite ja käigukastide remont ning vahetus. - Tehniliste rikete diagnoosimine ja kõrvaldamine. - Erinevate sõidukite tehnilise seisukorra kontrollimine. - Vajadusel osalemine sõidukite taastamis- ja ümberehitusprojektides. Töö on mitmekülgne ning hõlmab nii tavapäraseid remonditöid kui ka keerukamaid tehnilisi lahendusi. Ootame töötajalt iseseisvat tööoskust, kohusetundlikkust ja kvaliteetset tööde teostamist.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt oskustele ja kogemustele.- Stabiilset ja pikaajalist töösuhet. - Hästi varustatud töökoda kaasaegsete töövahendite ja seadmetega. - Mitmekülgset ja huvitavat tööd erinevate automarkidega. - Võimalust töötada Ameerika autode, klassikaliste sõidukite ja eriprojektidega. - Sõbralikku ning toetavat meeskonda. - Võimalust erialaselt areneda ja oma oskusi täiendada. - Hetkel töötame neljapäevase töönädala alusel, mis võimaldab nautida kolme järjestikust vaba päeva

Muud nõuded: Ootame oma meeskonda hea tehnilise taibuga ja kohusetundlikku inimest, kellel on huvi autotehnika vastu. Oluliseks peame: - Autode ehituse ja tööpõhimõtete tundmist. - Oskust kasutada tavapäraseid autoremonditööriistu. - Iseseisvat mõtlemist ja probleemide lahendamise oskust. - Täpsust ja kohusetundlikku suhtumist töösse. - Soovi õppida ja oma oskusi arendada. Varasem töökogemus automehaanikuna tuleb kasuks, kuid ei ole kohustuslik. Hindame eelkõige praktilisi oskusi ja tehnilist taipu. Ameerika autode tundmine ja B-kategooria juhiluba tulevad kasuks, kuid ei ole kohustuslikud.

title: Autoplekksepp
description:
Tööülesanded: • Sõidukite kerede remont, taastamine ja roostekahjustuste kõrvaldamine.• Vanemate sõidukite keredetailide taastamine ja vajadusel uute detailide valmistamine. • Puuduvate või kahjustatud plekkdetailide valmistamine näidise või olemasoleva kereosa järgi. • Pleki lõikamine, painutamine, vormimine, sobitamine ja keevitamine. • Roostetanud kereosade eemaldamine ning asendamine uute või omavalmistatud detailidega. • Keredetailide täpne sobitamine ja kvaliteetne viimistlemine. • Iseseisev töö planeerimine ning sobivate remondi- ja taastamislahenduste leidmine. Töö eeldab head plekitööoskust, tehnilist taiplikkust, täpsust ja loomingulist lähenemist. Oluline on oskus valmistada keredetaile ka olukorras, kus valmis varuosi ei ole saadaval.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Suurepäraseid töötingimusi – korralikud, avarad ja hästi varustatud tööruumid, kus on mugav ja meeldiv töötada.• Tipptasemel töövahendeid – sinu käsutuses on MIG/MAG- ja TIG-keevitusseadmed, inglise ratas, Power Hammer, painutuspingid ning palju muud professionaalset varustust. • Põnevaid ja väljakutseid pakkuvaid projekte – võimalust taastada vanu autosid, valmistada erilahendusi ja teha tõelist meistritööd. • Sõbralikku ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda – töötad koos inimestega, kes hindavad head huumorit, üksteise abistamist ja kvaliteetset tööd. • Vabadust oma oskusi rakendada – hindame iseseisvat mõtlemist, nutikaid lahendusi ja meisterlikkust. • Väga head teenimisvõimalust – oskame hinnata head töömeest ning oleme valmis kvaliteetse ja tulemusliku töö eest maksma väärilist tasu. Kui sulle meeldib oma kätega midagi erilist luua, hindad häid tööriistu ja tahad näha oma töö üle uhkust tundmist väärt tulemust, siis meie juures on sul selleks kõik võimalused!

Muud nõuded: Millist inimest oma meeskonda ootame?Täpset ja põhjalikku – hindad kvaliteeti, pöörad tähelepanu detailidele ja tunned uhkust oma töö üle. Tehniliselt taiplikku ja leidlikku – oskad iseseisvalt mõelda, probleeme lahendada ja vajadusel nutikaid lahendusi välja töötada. Kannatlikku ja järjekindlat – mõistad, et kvaliteetne taastamistöö nõuab aega, pühendumist ja täpsust. Iseseisvat ja vastutustundlikku – oskad oma tööd planeerida, võtad vastutuse tulemuse eest ja pead kokkulepetest kinni. Õpihimulist ja arenemissooviga – tunned huvi uute töövõtete vastu ja soovid oma meisterlikkust pidevalt täiendada. Positiivset ja meeskonnahingega – oled sõbralik, koostööaldis ja aitad kaasa heale töökeskkonnale. Kõige olulisem on, et sul oleks tõeline huvi autode taastamise ja plekitöö vastu, head käelised oskused ning soov teha tööd, mille üle saad ise uhkust tunda.

title: Laevade raadioside- ja navigatsiooniseadmete paigaldaja
description:
Field Engineer. Oleme valmis välja õpetama motiveeritud kandidaadi, kellel on algteadmised raadionavigatsioonist ja nõrkvooluelektrist.

Tööülesanded: Millega tuleb tegeleda: • Tuntud tootjate, nagu Sperry Marine, Wärtsilä/Transas, Furuno, JRC, Sailor, Raytheon jt navigatsiooni- ja raadiosideseadmete paigaldamine, seadistamine ja kasutuselevõtt. • Väljasõidud laevadele üle Eesti, vajadusel ka välisriikidesse. • Seadmete diagnostika, korraline hooldus, rikete tuvastamine ja kõrvaldamine ning remont. • Töö elektrijuhtmestiku ning raadio- ja elektroonikaseadmetega. • Iga-aastaste raadioside ülevaatuste läbiviimine ja tehnilise dokumentatsiooni koostamine. • Vastavuse tagamine SOLAS-i, IMO ja lipuriigi nõuetele. • Täpse hooldusdokumentatsiooni pidamine ning suhtlemine laevameeskonnaga. • Osalemine seadmete moderniseerimise ja uuendamise projektides.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Personaalset töökohta.• Tööriideid ja töövahendeid. • Tervisekindlustust. • Tööd ühes vahetuses (õhtu- ja öövahetused puuduvad, kuid võib esineda ületunde). • Sõbralikku ja professionaalset kollektiivi. • Kohapealset tööd (kaugtöö võimalus puudub). • Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt kandidaadi teadmistele ja kogemustele. • Arenguvõimalusi ning töötasu kasvu koos professionaalse arenguga. • Kontorit Lasnamäel. • Töötasu on kokkuleppel ja sõltub kandidaadi kvalifikatsioonist. • Pakume võimalust omandada teadmisi laevaseadmete, GMDSS-süsteemide ja satelliitsidesüsteemide paigaldamise ning hooldamise valdkonnas.

Muud nõuded: • Haridus elektroonika, telekommunikatsiooni või mereinseneri erialal või samaväärne töökogemus.• Vähemalt 2-aastane töökogemus navigatsiooni- ja raadiosidesüsteemide ning nõrkvoolusüsteemidega. • Head teadmised GMDSS-, ECDIS-, radari-, AIS-, GPS- ja VDR-süsteemidest. • Kehtiv GOC või ROC sertifikaat (eeliseks). • Oskus iseseisvalt diagnoosida ja lahendada tehnilisi probleeme. • Arusaam elektrivoolust ja pingest, alalis- ja vahelduvvoolust ning ühe- ja kolmefaasilistest toitesüsteemidest. • Valmidus töölähetusteks Eestis ja välismaal. • Hea kliendisuhtlemisoskus. • Arusaam ärikirjavahetuse põhimõtetest. • Inglise keele oskus; teiste võõrkeelte oskus tuleb kasuks. • Viisakus, professionaalsus ja soov areneda. • Valmidus õppida ning omandada uusi oskusi. • B-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu. • Oleme valmis välja õpetama motiveeritud kandidaadi, kellel on algteadmised raadionavigatsioonist ja nõrkvooluelektrist.

title: Rasketehnika ja erilahenduste tehnik
description:
Tööülesanded: Kõiki tehnilisi töid ei saa teha hooldusjuhendi järgi. Mõnikord tuleb sobiv lahendus ise välja mõelda, valmistada ja tööle panna.Kui sulle meeldib lisaks remondile ehitada, kohandada ning lahendada tehnilisi ülesandeid, millele valmis vastust alati olemas ei ole, võib Gravenori Pärnu esindus olla just sinu järgmine töökoht. Gravenori Pärnu esinduses tegeleme lisaks tehnika hooldusele ja remondile suuremate ümberehituste, pealisehituste ning kliendi vajadustele loodud erilahendustega. Ühel päeval võib töös olla tõstuki või rasketehnika remont, järgmisel hüdraulika- või elektrisüsteemi ümberehitus ning seejärel suurem projekt, kus masinale tuleb sobiv lahendus valmistada, paigaldada ja tööle seadistada. Töö hõlmab sõltuvalt projektist: - rasketehnika, tõste- ja laotehnika remonti; - mehaanika-, hüdraulika- ja elektritöid; - masinate ning seadmete ümberehitamist; - pealisehituste ja lisaseadmete paigaldamist; - rikete diagnoosimist ja tehniliste lahenduste leidmist; - suuremate eriprojektide teostamist algusest lõpuni. Siin ei ole iga tööpäev ühesugune ning alati ei piisa ainult detaili väljavahetamisest. Oluline on oskus kaasa mõelda, leida töötav lahendus ja viia alustatud töö lõpuni.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Mitmekülgset tööd erinevate masinate ja projektidega.- Võimalust osaleda suuremates ümberehitustes ja erilahenduste loomises. - Kaasaegseid töövahendeid ja süsteemset töökorraldust - Kogenud meeskonna tuge. - Tööks vajalikke ja sinu arengusoovidele vastavaid koolitusi. - Võimalust kasutada ning edasi arendada oma tehnilisi oskusi. - Töötasu alates 2300 € bruto, sõltuvalt kogemusest ja oskustest. - Võimalust töötada uutmoodi, süsteemselt üles ehitatud ja pidevalt arenevas tehnikateeninduses.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui sul on tehniline taip, varasem kogemus masinate või seadmete remondiga ning soov teha midagi enamat kui tavapärased hooldustööd. Kasuks tuleb kogemus mehaanika, hüdraulika, elektri, keevituse või diagnostikaga. Kõike ei pea kohe oskama – tähtis on praktiline mõtlemine, õppimisvõime ja huvi keerukamate tehniliste tööde vastu.

title: Hooldustehnik
description:
Tööülesanded: Kulunud voolik, lõtk liigendites või ebatavaline heli - hea hooldustehnik märkab asju, millest võib hiljem saada suurem probleem. Ta tunneb masina vastu huvi ja tahab, et tehtud töö järel saaks sellele kindel olla. Kui selline suhtumine iseloomustab ka sind, tule Gravenori meeskonda! Otsime Tallinna esindusse hooldustehnikut. Sinu peamine töö on tõstukite, laotehnika ja teiste tõsteseadmete hooldamine ning mehaaniliste ja hüdrauliliste sõlmede remont. Töötad nii meie töökojas kui ka klientide juures. Sinu tööülesanded on: - Masinate korraline hooldus ja tehnilise seisukorra kontroll. - Õlide, filtrite, vedelike ja kuluvosade vahetamine. - Mastide, kettide, liigendite ja teiste liikuvate osade kontroll, määrimine ning reguleerimine. - Pidurite, roolisüsteemide ja veermiku hooldus ning remont. - Hüdraulikavoolikute, ühenduste ja silindrite kontroll ning remont. - Avastatud puuduste ja tehtud tööde dokumenteerimine. - Masina töö ja ohutuse kontroll pärast hooldust või remonti.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Töötasu alates 2500 € bruto, lähtudes sinu oskustest ja kogemustest.- Tööd mitmete premium-brändide tehnikaga ning võimalust arendada oma oskusi erinevate masinate ja tehniliste lahendustega töötades. - Vaheldusrikast tööd erinevate masinatega nii töökojas kui ka klientide juures. - Selget töökorraldust ja uudset digitaalset lahendust, mis annab sulle tööülesanded ja vajaliku info mugavalt kätte ning teeb tehtud tööde märkimise lihtsaks. - Kogenud meeskonna tuge - saad nõu küsida ja keerulisemaid töid koos lahendada. - Võimalust arendada oma oskusi hoolduse, mehaanika ja hüdraulika valdkonnas. - Võimalust kaasa rääkida töökorralduse ja töövõtete parandamisel. Hindame sinu praktilisi tähelepanekuid ja ettepanekuid.

Muud nõuded: Ootame praktilise mõtlemisega inimest, kes tunneb tööriistu, saab aru masinate ehitusest ja teeb oma tööd hoolikalt.Kasuks tuleb varasem kogemus tõstukite, põllumajandus-, ehitus- või rasketehnika hooldamisel ja remontimisel. Oluline on mehaanika ja hüdraulika tundmine, oskus hinnata detailide seisukorda ning soov oma teadmisi täiendada. Ootame sinult: - Tehnilist taipu ja oskust leida praktilisi lahendusi. - Hoolikust ning vastutust oma töö kvaliteedi eest. - Valmisolekut töötada iseseisvalt ja teha koostööd meeskonnaga. - Oskust märgata puudusi ja anda neist selgelt teada. - Vähemalt B-kategooria juhiluba. Kõiki meie juures teenindatavaid masinaid ei pea sa esimesest päevast tundma - oluline on hea tehniline põhi ja tahtmine õppida.

title: Senior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional.

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an engineer who rapidly turns promising image- and video-generation techniques into evaluated, shipped MyArchitectAI features. This is hands-on product building: not pure research, and not a pure inference/infrastructure job. - In your first 30 days you ship a meaningful improvement, scoped with a founder: a new AI capability, a quality or speed gain, an evaluation system, or automation of manual work. You back it with visual examples and numbers. - By 60 days you find an opportunity yourself (new models, user data, weak spots in our pipeline), propose it and ship it. - By 90 days you have three or more shipped contributions and own the loop: find → evaluate → build → validate → ship → learn. - You keep a clear view of new models, techniques and competitors without chasing novelty for its own sake.

We offer: - Working directly with the founders, with real impact on the product.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Salary negotiable.

Other requirements: You have:- Hands-on work with generative image or video models (not only LLMs, RAG or agents). - At least one shipped product, deployed feature, meaningful open-source contribution, or convincing end-to-end project, and you can say exactly what you built. - Experience running experiments and making quality vs. speed vs. cost decisions. - The engineering skills to take a notebook or demo into a real product (Python, production-quality code). - Good written English (our working language). Estonian is not required. Nice to have: Diffusers, ComfyUI, ControlNet-style conditioning, inpainting and editing, LoRA and fine-tuning, video models, upscaling; your own evaluation datasets or benchmarks; GPU deployment and optimisation; 3D, AEC, CAD, rendering or interiors; public code, demos, models or write-ups.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors. Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus). - Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

title: Product Engineer
description:
Work tasks: Hausing is a dedicated property management software platform that helps commercial property managers and owners save time through automation and gain a real-time overview with centralized portfolio data. The solution replaces manual and unreliable spreadsheets, allowing users to track lease changes, special agreements, work orders, utilities, and analytics in one place. Core features include task management, lease management, automated preventive maintenance calendars, and automated utility cost sharing with quick invoice generation. Hausing also provides robust analytics, such as rent-rolls, task reports, vacancy reports, and tenant changes, in both spreadsheet and visual formats. The team focuses on building practical, data-driven tools that make property operations more efficient and transparent. What you'll do: - Design and develop reliable, user-friendly solutions that make a real difference for our customers. - Work closely with stakeholders to ensure business needs align with technical capabilities. - Take part in cross-functional initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve long-term scalability. - Proactively identify and solve complex problems. - Share your knowledge and help drive engineering excellence across the team.

We offer: Benefits:- Professional development and career growth opportunities. - Autonomy in organizing and managing your own work. - A modern and inspiring work environment. - An inclusive company culture where employees' opinions are valued and taken into account. - Remote work opportunities. - Flexible working hours. - Flexible arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance.

Other requirements: What we're looking for:- Strong skills in Java development and familiarity with React or similar frameworks. - Experience in building technical solutions for complex business logic. - Experience in API design and/or service-oriented architecture. - Solid competence in working with relational databases. - Familiarity with AWS or similar environments. - An AI-first mindset and curiosity to explore how AI can improve both your workflow and the products you build. - Familiarity with product engineering methodologies. - Willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment. - Courage to take responsibility, show initiative, and give constructive feedback. - Proficiency in Estonian language is a plus.

Option to work from home: No

title: Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, ABB Oy Motion Service

In this role, you will support the coordination and delivery of learning programs, digital training solutions, and learning platforms while collaborating with stakeholders across a global organization.About the RoleAs a Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting and coordinating global learning and training initiatives within the Motion Global Capability Team of Motion Service organization. What matters most is your interest in digital learning solutions, willingness to learn, and understanding of how effective learning experiences are built.We hope you bring:· An interest in learning, development, and digital training environments· Confidence in using common digital workplace tools and platforms· Strong communication and coordination skills when working with different stakeholders· A structured and well-organized approach to managing tasks and priorities· The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others· A proactive, flexible, and solution-oriented mindset, with curiosity and a willingness to learn and take initiative· Fluent English skills, as English is the daily working language and the official language used across the organization in this roleWhat Makes You Successful in This RoleYou thrive in collaborative and international environments and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders. You are motivated by improving learning experiences and supporting digital training initiatives that make a real impact across a global organization. With a proactive mindset and eagerness to learn, you apply best practices, work effectively within established processes, and contribute to an inclusive, safe, and supportive team culture.What We OffersABB is a global technology company where you will become part of an international yet close-knit team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in learning and training while building a long-term career within a global organization.The position is a fixed-term assignment of one year, with a preferred start date as soon as possible. The collective agreement is for senior salaried employees in the technology industryThe role offers full remote flexibility. However, we hope that the selected candidate will be able to visit the office at Pitäjänmäki occasionally to collaborate with the team and maintain personal connections with colleagues.While the position does not involve regular travel, you will work closely with international colleagues and stakeholders in a global environment. The role provides an excellent opportunity to expand your expertise within an international organization and contribute to the development of learning and digital training solutions across a broad global network.ContactApply through our website www.adecco.fi [http://www.adecco.fi] by submitting your CV and a short cover letter including your salary expectation.Interviews will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate. title: Power Platform Advisor - AI & Solution Architecture
description: **We are looking for an experienced professional who wants to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, useful solutions—and help customers make the right choices along the way. This role brings together business insight, solution architecture and hands-on development. You will help customers discover what is worth building, shape the solution, and stay involved in making it real.****About the role**You will work closely with customers to understand their challenges, processes and constraints—and uncover the real need behind the initial request. You will turn those discussions into viable opportunities, sound architectural choices and an actionable delivery plan. Depending on the assignment, you may take the work from discovery and solution shaping through implementation, deployment and further development.This is not a role for a purely high-level architect. We are looking for someone who can design the bigger picture, document the decisions that matter, and still build or validate key parts of the solution.Our home ground is Microsoft Power Platform and the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem. Depending on the assignment, your toolkit may include Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, API Management, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub and GitHub Copilot.**What you could be working on**The exact mix will depend on the customer and assignment, but your work could include:- Leading stakeholder discussions to uncover the real business need and decide what is worth building. - Turning requirements into scalable solution architectures, data models, integration designs and practical delivery plans. - Designing and delivering intelligent applications, agents and automation with Power Platform, Azure and related services. - Creating clear architecture diagrams, technical notes and decision records that make assumptions, constraints and trade-offs visible. - Building and validating key parts of the solution yourself, while giving concrete technical guidance to the wider delivery team. - Helping customers make informed choices about feasibility, security, maintainability, lifecycle and good engineering practices. **Your background could look like this**You might currently describe yourself as a solution architect, application architect, technical consultant or senior developer. Perhaps you are a Power Platform professional who has worked with complex integrations, Azure services, and enterprise application architecture. Or you may come from pro-code software development and have moved towards architecture and consulting. There is more than one route into this role.What matters most is your ability to combine three perspectives:1\. **Technology:** You understand how modern applications are designed and built. You can discuss architecture, integrations, APIs, data, identity and security, and you are comfortable going into technical detail.2\. **Business:** You can uncover the actual need behind a request, ask the right questions, and help the customer decide what is worth building.3\. **Delivery:** You can turn plans, experiments and architectural choices into working, maintainable solutions.You do not need to arrive knowing every technology. However, you do need enough technical depth to make informed decisions independently, recognize risks and learn unfamiliar technologies without waiting for a predefined path.Above all, we value curiosity, sound judgement and a continuous learning mindset.**What we are looking for:**Titles matter less than what you can do. We are looking for someone who:- Enjoys solving business problems with technology - Can design the bigger picture without losing touch with implementation - Is excited about AI and modern Microsoft technologies & has experience working with both areas - Feels comfortable discussing architecture with developers and business stakeholders alike - Has experience delivering customer-facing projects and building trusted relationships - Wants to keep learning and sharing knowledge with others - Has fluent communication and presentation skills in Finnish and English Above all, we highly appreciate applicants with a continuous learning mindset.You will be part of our experienced Power Platform masterminds. On average, your colleagues have 5–20 years of relevant experience each, so you'll get to be part of an experienced group of experts.\*\*\***What to expect from the recruitment process**- Application period 27.10.–29.11.2026 - First meeting with Päivikki, team lead, and Poola, People & Culture - Second, more technical meeting with potential future colleagues - Preferred starting date according to agreement, in the beginning of 2027 Any changes to the process will be communicated to the applicants.**What we offer**- A central role where you can make an impact! - A great work home for professionals – our eNPS is 82! - A caring employer where we focus on impact and thriving together – who also supports continuous learning - Supportive, balanced and collaborative work environment & a culture which is built on trust - Flexible working hours and location (unlimited remote work according to company policy); https://careers.forwardforever.com/posts/remote-hybrid-or-office-honestly-we-don-t-label-it - Comprehensive company benefits including an additional health insurance Expected compensation will be within the range of 5000-6500 €/month.We are looking forward to hearing from you! Please send your resume and application letter at the latest on 29.11.2026 through our job ad. We will not just wait for the application period to hit its deadline, and neither should you! We will go through the applications already during the application period and fill the position as soon as we find the right person.If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to reach out to Poola, poola.isomaki@forwardforever.com. Please note that we use emails as part of our communication so double check that you have added an email address that you follow regularly.**Let's change the game, together!**

title: Power BI & Fabric Developer

You'll own solutions end to end, from the data platform to the semantic model and the reports and apps people use every day.Our key goal is to give our customers solid foundations for their data & AI journey. And you'll be the one building them. Title-wise at FF you'll be a Data Advisor.**In practice, you will:**- Build reports and agents that people actually use, from the first sketch to production - Design and develop semantic models - Build and configure the data platform underneath, e.g. Fabric lakehouses and warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, pipelines or Azure SQL - Make our customers' data AI-ready: well-modelled, governed data and semantic models that Copilot, data agents and other AI solutions can rely on - Work directly with customer stakeholders, turn their needs into working solutions and iterate quickly based on feedback **What you'll bring**- A doer's mindset: you take ownership, get things done and make technical decisions independently - Several years of hands-on experience in Power BI development, preferably in consulting or working with several customers or stakeholders - Proven experience in - Building Power BI reports and dashboards with a clear, user-friendly design - Semantic modelling and DAX - Transforming and querying data with e.g. Power Query (M) and SQL - Microsoft Fabric, e.g. lakehouses, warehouses and pipelines - Taking a solution from requirements all the way to production 1. Hands-on experience using AI in your daily work, e.g. AI-assisted or agentic development with tools like GitHub Copilot, and an understanding of what makes data and semantic models ready for AI 2. Ability to communicate fluently in Finnish and English **We also value**- Data engineering experience in Azure, e.g. Azure SQL, Data Factory or Synapse - Power BI lifecycle practices - Experience building AI solutions on top of data - Understanding of Fabric & Power BI governance, security and capacity management - Experience with the rest of Power Platform, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. In our projects, Power BI is usually combined with the other tools one way or another. Above all, we highly appreciate applicants with a continuous learning mindset.You will be part of our Data team with fellow data master minds, so you'll get to be part of an experienced group of experts.\*\*\*Get familiarized with Forward Forever as a workplace: https://careers.forwardforever.com/ and if you want to get to know the Data team lead, Konsta, better, read his blog: https://forwardforever.com/meet-our-people-konsta-hintsala-power-platform-advisor-team-lead/.**What to expect from the recruitment process**- Application period 27.10.–22.11.2026 - First meeting with Konsta, team lead, and Poola, People & Culture - Second, more technical meeting with potential future colleagues - Preferred starting date according to agreement, in the beginning of 2027 Any changes to the process will be communicated to the applicants.**What we offer**- A central role where you can make an impact! - Modern ways of working: where possible, we develop reports agentically, and you get to help shape how we do it - A great work home for data professionals – our eNPS is 82! - A caring employer where we focus on impact and thriving together – who also supports continuous learning - Supportive, balanced and collaborative work environment & a culture which is built on trust - Flexible working hours and location (unlimited remote work according to company policy); read more about our views on this: https://careers.forwardforever.com/posts/remote-hybrid-or-office-honestly-we-don-t-label-it - Comprehensive company benefits including an additional health insurance Our salary model offers levels based on skills and taking ownership. Your compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process based on the salary model. We strive to be an organization where everyone is supported to grow and can advance in their career. Expected compensation will be within the range of 4500-6500 €/month.We are looking forward to hearing from you! Please send your resume and application letter at the latest on 22.11.2026 through our job ad. We will not just wait for the application period to hit its deadline, and neither should you! We will go through the applications already during the application period and fill the position as soon as we find the right person.If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to reach out to Poola, poola.isomaki@forwardforever.com. Please note that we use emails as part of our communication so double check that you have added an email address that you follow regularly.**Let's change the game, together!**_AI in our recruitment process: Decisions are never made by AI, and AI does not automatically process applications or communicate with applicants. A person reviews every application, decides who moves forward and sends the messages._

title: Transport planner
description: **We are looking for a Transport Planner to Kokkola!**In Transport Planning, you are responsible for the customers in your geographical area. You take customer orders, make sure they are correct, and plan them into complete loads ready for transport. You are at the start of the customer flow, so every transport begins with your work. The Route Planner take it from there.The job is teamwork: Sales, Transport Planning and Route Planning work together for the customer. It is also independent; you handle your own customers and make decisions quickly when things change.**Your responsibilities****Customer service and orders**- serve customers professionally and be their point of contact - receive and confirm customer orders and make sure they are correct - stay in active contact with customers to make sure volumes are right **Transport planning**- plan customer orders into complete loads and book capacity for them - handle ferry bookings and make sure the best ferry connections are used efficiently - buy external capacity when needed, following the agreed routine - handle changes and deviations during transport and keep the customer informed - optimise the days transport flows together with the planning side - work with Sales on matters such as pricing and customer agreements **You bring**- an interest in logistics, customer service and sales - a service mindset and a wish to build long-term customer relationships - the ability to prioritise and make decisions when things change - clear communication, also when things get busy - a willingness to work closely with sales, planners and customers - the ability to communicate effectively in Swedish, Finnish and English - experience in logistics or customer service is a plus **You will learn with us**- the Ahola Way, our values and how we work - transport planning, load planning and ferry traffic - the market and its price levels - our own transport management system **What we offer**- a varied role where no two days are the same - a thorough introduction and colleagues who help you succeed - a secure workplace in a growing Nordic family company - a culture built on our values: total responsibility, openness and respect for the individual The position is permanent. Salary is determined according to the Collective Agreement. In addition, the employee's competence and work experience are taken into account when setting the salary.

title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri, Vantaan Energia
description: Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Energialle kahta kunnossapitoinsinööriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.Olemme yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kaupunkienergiayhtiöistä ja Suomen suurin jätteen energiahyödyntäjä. Tuotamme ja toimitamme lämpöä ja sähköä sekä tarjoamme näihin liittyviä palveluita. Ratkaisemme asiakkaidemme haasteita varmistamalla, että energia kiertää mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta, jotta vantaalaisilla olisi tarjolla edullista, toimitusvarmaa ja yhä vähäpäästöisempää energiaa sekä siihen liittyviä palveluita nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Kunnianhimoisten suunnitelmiemme ydin on osaava, motivoitunutja hyvinvoiva henkilöstömme, josta huolehtiminen on meille ykkösasia. www.vantaanenergia.fiTehtäväTehtävät sijoittuvat korkealämpötilalaitokselle (HWP) ja jätevoimala 2-laitokselle. Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat oman laitoksesi kunnossapitotoiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja toimintavarmuudesta. Kyseessä on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen asiantuntija-sekä esihenkilörooli, jossa toimit oman laitoksen kunnossapidon vetäjänä. Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa laitoksen turvallinen, tehokas ja häiriötön toiminta sekä tuotanto-omaisuuden pitkäjänteinen kehittäminen.Tehtävässä toimit kunnossapidon tiimin esihenkilönä sekä vastaat ulkoistenpalveluntarjoajien ja alihankkijoiden ohjauksesta. Osallistut myös kunnossapidon budjetointiin, investointien suunnitteluun sekä kehityshankkeisiin yhteistyössä tuotannon, käytön ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:- oman laitoksen kunnossapitotoiminnan sekä tiimin johtaminen ja kehittäminen- tuotantolaitoksen käytettävyyden, turvallisuuden ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen- kunnossapidon pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelu ja kehitystyö- kunnossapidon budjetointiin osallistuminen sekä kustannusten seuranta- hankintojen, kilpailutusten ja ulkoisten palveluiden koordinointi- kunnossapidon KPI-mittareiden ja tunnuslukujen seuranta sekä kehittäminen- alihankkijoiden työn ohjaus ja valvonta- yhteistyö tuotannon, käytön, omaisuudenhallinnan sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa- lakisääteisten velvollisuuksien ja turvallisuusvaatimusten noudattamisen varmistaminen.Tarjoamme sinulleTarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa kokonaisvastuun oman energiantuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta osana vakavaraista ja tulevaisuuteen katsovaa energia-alan yritystä. Pääset työskentelemään keskeisessä roolissa, jossa vaikutat suoraan laitoksen suorituskykyyn, turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, osaavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi ja johtamisosaamistasi energia-alan mielenkiintoisimpien tehtävien parissa.Toivomme sinulta- soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa esim. kone- tai energiatekniikka (insinööri tai DI)- usean vuoden kokemusta kunnossapitotehtävistä prosessiteollisuudessa- voimalaitos-, energia- tai kaukolämpötekniikan tuntemusta- ymmärrystä kunnossapidon menetelmistä ja kehittämisestä- hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaitoja ja valmiuksia toimia esihenkilötehtävistä- kehitysmyönteistä, suunnitelmallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa- hankinta- ja kilpailutusosaaminen katsotaan eduksi- kiinteiden polttoaineiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja solmitaan suoraan Vantaan Energia Oy:n kanssa.Barona toimii rekrytointikumppanina.Oletko sinä uusi energia-alan huipputekijä?Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävät täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Tietosuojasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tai WhatsAppin kautta.Tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, työhöntulotarkastusta sekä huumausainetestausta. Nämä toteutetaan valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen alkamista.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Katri Hyppänen, Seniorikonsultti, Barona Teknisetasiantuntijat p. 050 439 9785 ma-to klo 10-14.

title: Trainee, Test Systems & Data
description: We are hiring two trainees to work with the systems and data behind product testing in manufacturing. As part of our Test Systems & Data team, you will see how measurement technology, test automation, software development, and data engineering come together in practice. One trainee may focus mainly on Manufacturing Test Systems and the other on Manufacturing Data, but both may work across the two areas. The focus is flexible, and tasks will be selected based on each candidates background and interests and the teams current needs. Interested? Keep reading!Depending on your background and interests, you may work in one or both focus areas. In Manufacturing Test Systems, you could help develop and improve the systems used to test products, including automation, software, and scripts. You may also work with measurement equipment and instrument interfaces, support test execution, validation, and data collection, troubleshoot existing systems, and maintain technical documentation. In Manufacturing Data, you could process, analyze, and visualize manufacturing and test data. This may involve databases and SQL, data pipelines, APIs and integrations, data quality and traceability, or automated reports, dashboards, and analytics. You will complete practical engineering and development tasks with guidance from experienced engineers, and you will not be expected to cover every topic listed.These positions suit university students in automation, electrical or electronics engineering, measurement technology, computer science, software engineering, data engineering, industrial engineering with relevant technical or data studies, or another related field. Some programming experience from studies, projects, personal projects, thesis work, or previous employment will help you get started. We are looking for systematic problem-solvers who enjoy working hands-on with technical systems, data, or both. You should be ready to document your work clearly, learn unfamiliar tools and technologies, and communicate and work in English.Previous experience in any of these areas can give you a useful starting point, but it is not required: programming with Python or another language; SQL, databases, data pipelines, APIs, or integrations; Power BI or another reporting tool; electrical measurement equipment, electronics, software-controlled instruments, interfaces, or test automation; Git or GitLab; and technical documentation. You do not need experience in every area listed. We are interested in your technical foundation, interests, and ability to learn.You will work on practical engineering and development tasks in a technical manufacturing environment, with support from experienced engineers. Through the work, you can learn how test systems are developed and maintained, how manufacturing data is handled and used, and how engineers document, test, and improve technical solutions. Your experience may center on measurement technology, automation, software, manufacturing data, or a combination of these areas.Main responsibilities: * The actual responsibilities will depend on each trainees focus area, background, and the teams current needs. * Support the development and improvement of manufacturing test systems, test automation, software, and scripts * Work with measurement equipment, instrument interfaces, test execution, validation, and test-data collection * Process, analyze, and visualize manufacturing and test data * Support the development of databases, data pipelines, integrations, reports, and dashboards * Help improve manufacturing data quality and product-to-test-result traceability * Troubleshoot technical issues and maintain clear technical documentation * Complete assigned development and testing tasks with guidance from experienced engineersWhat we expect from you * Ongoing studies in a relevant technical field * Some programming experience gained through studies, projects, personal projects, thesis work, or previous employment * Problem-solving skills and a systematic approach to work * Willingness to work hands-on with technical systems, data, or both * Ability to document work and results clearly * Willingness to learn unfamiliar tools and technologies * Excellent command of English, both written and spokenWe also appreciate * Experience with Python or another relevant programming language * Experience with SQL, databases, data pipelines, APIs, or integrations * Experience with Power BI or another visualization and reporting tool * Familiarity with electrical measurement equipment, electronics, instrument interfaces, or test automation * Familiarity with Git, GitLab, or another version-control system * Experience producing clear technical documentation * Note, that these are preferred qualifications, not mandatory requirements.There are two trainee positions, and the work will start as soon as possible. The contracts are fixed-term and will run through 2027. Initially, the trainees will work approximately three days per week on an hourly basis. From May through September, the positions will be full-time. The work will be primarily on-site, but some remote work may be possible once the person can work independently.Please apply as soon as possible, on November 12, 2026, at the latest through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.For more information, please contact our Manager, Test Systems & Data, Mikko Peurala, at mikko.peurala@bluefors.com [mikko.peurala@bluefors.com].

title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland**Application deadline:** 12.11.2026Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?**What will you be doing?**SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.**Key responsibilities**In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.**We hope you have:**- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work. - Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly. - Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services. - Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English. - Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style. - Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities. **We consider as an asset:**- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials. - Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods. - Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services. - Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production. - Experience in international manufacturing environments. - Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation. **What SpinDrive offers you:**- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications - Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality - Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks - Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe - Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition - The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth. **Practicalities:**This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible.

title: Liikunnanohjaaja
description: Olisitko sinä seuraava liikuntaihmeiden mahdollistaja?Etsimme Iisalmen kaupungille liikunnanohjaajaa vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävä sijoittuu liikuntapalveluihin sivistys- ja hyvinvointitoimialalle. Työpiste sijaitsee Iisalmen uimahalli Saukossa, mutta liikunnanohjausta tehdään eri puolilla kaupunkia liikuntapaikoissa.Liikunnanohjaajana tehtäväsi on edistää kuntalaisten terveyttä, hyvinvointia ja toimintakykyä innostaen eri-ikäisiä kuntalaisia liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan. Vastaat liikuntaneuvonnan ja elintapaohjauksen toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä. Liikuntaryhmien suunnittelu sekä ohjaaminen erilaisille kohderyhmille erilaisissa liikuntaympäristöissä kuuluu tehtävänkuvaan. Tehtävässä vastaat myös uimahallin kuntosalin asiakasneuvonnasta, turvallisuudesta sekä kuntosalilaitteistosta.Kelpoisuusehtona on vähintään soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto liikunnan alalta tai vastaava aiempi soveltuva opistoasteinen tutkinto ja soveltuva työkokemus.Odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kokemusta liikunnanohjauksesta ja liikuntaneuvonnasta. Olet palveluhenkinen, innostava ja helposti lähestyttävä liikunta-alan ammattilainen. Omaat itseohjautuvan ja oma-aloitteisen työotteen. Toimit kehittämismyönteisesti osana liikuntapalveluiden tiimiä.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää monipuolisia liikunnanohjaustaitoja, tietoteknisiä perustaitoja, monipuolisia viestintätaitoja sekä kykyä tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä sidosryhmien kanssa. title: Toyota Auto Finland: IT Project Specialist
description: **Työsopimuksen tyyppi:** vakituinen, kokoaikainen**Sijainti:** Korpivaarantie 1, Vantaa**Hakuaika päättyy:** 11.11.2026Haluatko toimia avainroolissa liiketoiminnan ja IT:n välillä? Etsimme nyt IT Project Specialistia Toyotalle monipuoliseen asiantuntijarooliin!**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**IT Project Specialistina vastaat Toyotan liiketoimintaa tukevien IT-projektien suunnittelusta, koordinoinnista ja onnistuneesta toteutuksesta. Roolissa pääset toimimaan keskeisenä linkkinä liiketoiminnan, IT:n ja ulkoisten järjestelmätoimittajien välillä. Tunnistat ja selvität liiketoiminnan tarpeita, muutat niitä selkeiksi vaatimuksiksi IT-osastolle ja varmistat, että toteutettavat ratkaisut tukevat liiketoimintaprosesseja ja strategisia tavoitteita.Tehtävässä liityt osaksi Toyotan viiden hengen IT-tiimiä, jossa työskentelee eri osa-alueisiin erikoistuneita asiantuntijoita. Teet yhteistyötä sekä paikallisen liiketoiminnan että Toyotan kansainvälisen organisaation kanssa. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan myös Toyota Northern Europen yhteisten toimintatapojen ja järjestelmäratkaisujen kehittämiseen, jotta eri markkinoilla voidaan hyödyntää samoja ratkaisuja mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.**Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**Voit olla taustaltasi esimerkiksi IT-projektien parissa työskennellyt asiantuntija, IT-orientoitunut liiketoiminta-analyytikko tai teknisemmästä tehtävästä projektinhallintaan siirtynyt osaaja. Tärkeintä on, että ymmärrät sekä IT:n että liiketoiminnan näkökulmia ja osaat yhdistää ne toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aiempaa kokemusta autoalalta, mutta sen tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.**Sinulta odotamme:**- Tehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa esimerkiksi IT:n, tekniikan tai liiketalouden alalta - Vähintään muutaman vuoden relevanttia kokemusta esimerkiksi IT-projektinhallinnasta tai muusta IT:n ja liiketoiminnan rajapinnan tehtävistä - Kykyä ymmärtää liiketoiminnan tarpeita ja muuttaa ne selkeiksi IT-vaatimuksiksi - Hyviä projektien koordinointi-, vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja - Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:**- Autoalan liiketoiminnan tuntemus - Azuren, Snowflaken tai Microsoft 365 -teknologioiden, kuten Copilotin ja Power Automaten, tuntemus **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Laajan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääset yhdistämään IT-osaamisesi ja liiketoimintaymmärryksesi - Mahdollisuuden johtaa Toyotan keskeisiä IT-projekteja ja kehittää yhteisiä toimintatapoja - Kokeneen ja kannustavan tiimin, jossa osaamista jaetaan aktiivisesti ja kollegoilta saa aina tukea - Kansainvälisen toimintaympäristön sekä mahdollisuuden tehdä yhteistyötä Toyotan Euroopan organisaation kanssa - Hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten vapaa autoetu, kattava työterveyshuolto, liikunta- ja kulttuurietu sekä erilaiset henkilöstökerhot. **Käytännön asiat:**Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan Toyota Auto Finland Oy:lle. Tehtävässä aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee Vantaalla ja Toyotalla työskennellään tällä hetkellä hybridimallin mukaisesti vähintään kolme päivää viikossa toimistolla. Tehtävä sisältää satunnaista matkustamista kotimaassa sekä Pohjoismaissa ja Euroopassa yhteistyössä Toyota Motor Europen ja muiden kansainvälisten kollegoiden kanssa.

title: Kunnossapitopäällikkö
description: Kirkkonummi on kasvava, elinvoimainen ja kaksikielinen sivistyskunta, jonne muutetaan arjen sujuvuuden, turvallisuuden ja luonnonläheisyyden vuoksi. Helsingin läheisyydessä sijaitseva luonnonläheinen ja vireä Kirkkonummen kunta hakee innostunutta ja asiantuntevaa kunnossapitopäällikköä johtamaan infrapalveluiden kunnossapitopalvelut yksikköä. Hakemamme kunnossapitopäällikkö toimii yksikön esihenkilönä. Kunnossapitopalvelut yksikön tuottamat palvelut vaikuttavat jokaisen kuntalaisen jokapäiväiseen elämään. Kunnossapitopäällikön tehtävä on vakituinen virka.Kunnossapitopalvelut yksikkö vastaa kunnan katujen, puistojen ja muiden yleisten alueiden hoidosta ja kunnossapidosta. Tiimin vastuulla on myös kunnan hulevesitehtävät kunnossa- ja ylläpidon pidon osalta, vastuualueelle kuuluvat myös kunnan metsien hoito sekä hylättyjen ajoneuvojen käsittely.Viran kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi insinööri (AMK) tai aiempi vastaava tutkinto, sekä riittävä kokemus tehtäväalueeseen kuuluvista tehtävistä ja esimiestehtävistä. Toimialueen tehtävistä vaaditaan vähintään 5 vuoden työkokemus.Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää toimialan tuntemusta sekä vahvaa kokemusta infraomaisuuden yllä- ja kunnossapitoon liittyvistä tehtävistä. Odotamme kokemusta esihenkilönä olemisesta ja kehittävää työotetta. Toivomme saavamme joukkoomme dynaamisen ammattilaisen, jolla on sopimus- ja hankintaosaamista, asiakaspalvelu- ja yhteistyökykyä sekä hyviä neuvottelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Eduksi luetaan kehittämisvalmiudet, perehtyneisyys kunnallishallintoon sekä molempien kotimaisten kielten hallinta.Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työtehtävän mukavassa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä, kasvavassa pääkaupunkiseudun kehyskunnassa.Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Kunnallisen teknisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (TS) mukaisesti. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4 561,62 euroa/kk ja sen lisäksi maksetaan työkokemus- ja henkilökohtainen lisä. Työaika on 36,25 tuntia viikossa.Virka voidaan täyttää 1.12.2026 lukien tai sopimuksen mukaan. Viran täyttämisessä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.Hakemukset toimitetaan 12.11.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä Kuntarekryn sähköisellä lomakkeella www.kuntarekry.fi (työavain KIR-01-25-26).

Du guidar kunderna rätt bland bankens tjänster, produkter och smarta digitala verktyg.**Dina viktigaste fokusområden:**- Skapa hög tillgänglighet, tillit och kundnöjdhet tillsammans med dina kollegor, med sikte på att lösa kundens ärende direkt i det första mötet. - Ha ett skarpt öga för sälj- och servicemöjligheter genom ett proaktivt arbetssätt. - Du fångar upp kundens behov i samtalet och slussar dem vidare till våra privat- eller företagsrådgivare när det behövs för att bygga långsiktiga relationer. - Aktivt introducera och hjälpa kunderna att använda våra digitala tjänster utifrån deras unika behov. **Vem du är**För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du en lagspelare med mycket energi och ett genuint intresse för människor.**Vi söker dig som**- Har en naturlig fallenhet för att etablera kontakt och älskar att ge service i världsklass i mötet med både kunder och kollegor. - Triggas av att jobba resultatinriktat och ser det som en rolig utmaning att matcha kundens behov med rätt lösning. - Är nyfiken på ny teknik och trivs med att använda digitala verktyg i kundmötet. - Arbetar aktivt med att utveckla din egen kompetens och bidrar till ett öppet, dynamiskt och positivt klimat i teamet. - Pratar och skriver flytande finska och svenska samt har goda kunskaper i engelska. - Har en godkänd och fullständig gymnasieutbildning. **Vad vi erbjuder**Människor kommer till Nordea när de vill framåt. title: KVV IVV Supervisor
description: **Role Purpose**- **LVI-tyomaapaallikko (KVV- ja IV-tyonjohtaja) / HVAC and Plumbing Site Manager** - **The HVAC and Plumbing Site Manager leads the HVAC and plumbing works on site and also acts** **as the statutory KVV and IV supervisor (KVV- ja IV-tyonjohtaja) for the project. The role is accountable for delivering the works on time, within budget and in compliance with approved designs, Finnish regulations and technical standards, and is the technical and regulatory link between the project team, the Client, the General Contractor and the municipal building control authority (rakennusvalvonta), on complex, mission-critical facilities such as data centres.** **Key responsibilities**- **Site management: plan, coordinate and supervise the HVAC and plumbing works, manage subcontractors and site teams, and follow up schedule, costs and progress.** - **Statutory role: act as the approved KVV and IV supervisor for the project in accordance with the Finnish Building Act (Rakentamislaki 751/2023).** - **Compliance and quality: ensure installations comply with approved designs, legal requirements and technical standards, verify the quality of execution and promote best practices in safety, quality and efficiency.** - **Authorities and stakeholders: coordinate with the building control authority and inspectors, take part in coordination meetings with the Client, the General Contractor and other stakeholders, and plan and follow up official inspections.** - **Documentation and commissioning: maintain the KVV and IV inspection records, validate technical documentation, quality reports and commissioning dossiers, and support the commissioning team.** - **Company systems, HSE and quality: follow internal processes, Health and Safety and Environmental rules, the Management Policy and the Integrated Management System.** **Requirements**- **Valid Finnish qualification certificate (patevyystodistus) for KVV and IV supervision at the demand class required for the project.** - **Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC and plumbing site management or supervision.** - **Experience in data centres or other critical facilities.** - **Fluent English. Finnish strongly preferred.** **Possibility for accommodation. Travel costs are paid.**
