title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. Obiettivo del ruolo Gestire operativamente una o più commesse assicurando l'avanzamento regolare dei lavori e un controllo puntuale su programmazione, risorse, varianti, consegne e marginalità, con approccio pratico e orientamento al risultato. Responsabilità principali Condurre attività di valutazione dei rischi e contribuire alla stesura/aggiornamento del DVR e della documentazione correlata. Definire e implementare misure di prevenzione e protezione, monitorandone l'efficacia tramite audit, verifiche e indicatori. Contribuire agli adempimenti ambientali (autorizzazioni, prescrizioni, monitoraggi e attività analitiche). Mantenere e migliorare procedure e istruzioni operative del Sistema di Gestione secondo ISO 45001 e ISO 14001, supportando audit interni/esterni. Promuovere la cultura della sicurezza e programmi di sicurezza comportamentale, favorendo il coinvolgimento attivo dei lavoratori. Analizzare near miss, incidenti e infortuni con approccio root cause, definendo e tracciando azioni correttive/preventive. Collaborare con l'HSE Manager su iniziative di sostenibilità e miglioramento delle performance ambientali. Requisiti Laurea (preferibile indirizzo ingegneristico/tecnico con focus HSE o affini). Abilitazione ASPP (Moduli A e B). Esperienza consolidata in ruolo HSE in contesti manifatturieri/industriali. Conoscenza operativa delle norme ISO 45001 e ISO 14001. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per importante struttura sanitaria, stiamo cercando un/una: Senior IT Systems Specialist - Site Ownership La risorsa sarà l'unico presidio ICT interno della sede: garantirà continuità operativa e sicurezza dei servizi IT, gestendo in prima persona le attività tecniche e coordinando i fornitori, contribuendo anche a dare un indirizzo su priorità e roadmap locale in raccordo con Direzione e IT di gruppo. Responsabilità Presidio operativo IT di sede: gestione e supporto su postazioni, rete/Wi-Fi, stampanti/periferiche, sale e ambulatori; troubleshooting di 1°/2° livello, gestione ticket ed escalation. Sistemi informativi sanitari: configurazione, manutenzione e monitoraggio di applicativi (es. cartella clinica elettronica, prenotazioni/CUP, telemedicina e integrazioni correlate). Vendor management: punto di contatto per fornitori IT (assistenza applicativa/infrastrutturale), pianificazione interventi, verifica deliverable e qualità del servizio (SLA/KPI), escalation. Continuità di servizio: monitoraggio servizi critici, backup/restore, gestione incident e piani di ripristino in coordinamento con IT centrale. Sicurezza e compliance: applicazione delle policy e supporto a audit/controlli (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2 e linee guida interne), gestione accessi/utenze e aggiornamenti in raccordo con il gruppo. Indirizzo e miglioramento: raccolta esigenze dei reparti, proposta di priorità e interventi (quick win + strutturali), ottimizzazione dei flussi digitali clinico-amministrativi, supporto al change e formazione utenti. Requisiti Esperienza in ruoli IT con responsabilità end-to-end su sede/plant o contesti regolati; preferibile esposizione a healthcare. VMware/Proxmox, Veeam o equivalenti). Conoscenza database (SQL e principali RDBMS: Oracle/PostgreSQL, ecc.) a livello operativo. Autonomia, capacità di prioritizzazione, comunicazione efficace con utenti e Direzione; gestione di più attività in parallelo. Plus Esperienza con sistemi sanitari (es. H2O, Dedalus, TuoTempo o equivalenti) e integrazioni. Certificazioni (Microsoft, VMware, Fortinet, ITIL o simili). Esperienza su telemedicina e/o iniziative di cybersecurity in sanità. Italia

Full time

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. Budget: RAL 45.000€ in base all'effettiva seniority 2gg di settimanli Smart working Location Provincia di Monza SUD EST #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: responsabile di linea di autotrasporti
description: Our Client is an international industrial group, recognized for its structured finance governance and a strong focus on data accuracy, operational performance, and decision-making support. The successful candidate will partner with key internal stakeholders across the plant/operations organization and, when required, interact with external counterparts involved in stock audits and verification activities. title: consulente legale
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. For a client company operating in the technology and travel sector, we are looking for a: POLICY AND REGULATORY MANAGER - SOUTHERN EUROPE What will you be responsible for? Developing and implementing regulatory strategies and compliance solutions across Southern Europe, with a primary focus on Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Managing relationships with local and national governments, regulatory authorities, tax authorities and other institutional stakeholders. Monitoring and analysing tax and fiscal regulations, particularly those concerning short-term rentals, tourist tax collection, registration and data sharing. Managing agreements with Italian municipalities on tourist tax and supporting regulatory negotiations and legislative initiatives. Collaborating with legal, product and international teams to develop compliance tools, regulatory policies and solutions. Preparing policy papers, regulatory analyses and position statements, while identifying partnership opportunities with public institutions and external stakeholders. Do you have the following skills and qualifications? At least 7 years of relevant experience in tax, fiscal, regulatory and compliance matters. A degree in Law or a tax-related field is mandatory. Strong knowledge of the Italian regulatory framework and legislative processes; knowledge of other Southern European markets is an advantage. Proven experience in stakeholder management, institutional relations and complex project management. Excellent analytical, organisational, communication and negotiation skills. Fluency in Italian and English. Flexibility to travel frequently within Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours weekly. Contract offer: Employment through a fixed-term temporary agency contract. Applicable collective agreement (CCNL): Commerce. Classification level: Level 1. Salary: €84,000-€86,000 gross per year (RAL). Work location: Milan or Rome, with regular travel to Milan required for candidates based in Rome, including overnight stays, and frequent business travel across Southern Europe. If you have the skills and experience required for this role, we look forward to receiving your application! Grafton è il brand globale che si occupa di Professional Recruitment di Gi Group Holding, la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale. title: consulente in energia solare
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite-enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale #LI-CP Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-90K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description: .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. title: Database and network professionals
description: Grafton ICT* seleziona per azienda cliente che opera nel comparto assicurativo interamente partecipata dal Ministero dell'economia e delle finanze, uno/a Specialista Sicurezza Applicativa Descrizione del ruolo: Il/la candidato/a si occuperà di: - Supportare le attività di analisi e verifica della sicurezza applicativa, sia dal punto di vista dei processi sia delle componenti tecnologiche. - Collaborare alla definizione e all'applicazione delle best practice di sicurezza nell'ambito del ciclo di vita del software (Secure SDLC). - Effettuare controlli e valutazioni sulle configurazioni di sicurezza di piattaforme containerizzate (Kubernetes) e degli strumenti di gestione del codice sorgente e versioning (GitLab). - Supportare l'integrazione dei controlli di sicurezza nei processi DevSecOps/SecDevOps e nelle pipeline di sviluppo e rilascio del software. - Contribuire alle attività di verifica della sicurezza delle API e all'utilizzo degli strumenti di analisi e controllo dedicati. - Collaborare alla gestione delle soluzioni di identificazione e autenticazione, IAM, certificati digitali e protocolli di autenticazione (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, mutua autenticazione). Partecipare alle attività di progettazione e verifica della sicurezza di applicazioni distribuite in ambienti ibridi, on-premise e cloud. - Fornire supporto tecnico nelle attività di analisi delle vulnerabilità e definizione delle relative azioni di mitigazione. - Collaborare con i team di sviluppo, infrastruttura e sicurezza per garantire l'adozione dei requisiti di sicurezza applicativa. Requisiti richiesti Requisiti richiesti - Laurea triennale o magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Cyber Security o discipline affini. Saranno valutate anche candidature in possesso di diploma ad indirizzo informatico o tecnico, a fronte di una comprovata esperienza professionale coerente con il ruolo. - Costituiscono titolo preferenziale certificazioni e percorsi formativi specialistici in ambito Cyber Security, Application Security, DevSecOps e sicurezza delle piattaforme cloud e containerizzate. - Esperienza lavorativa di almeno 3/5 anni in ambito IT Security in contesti enterprise Windows e Linux. - Conoscenze delle principali architetture a container, con particolare riferimento a Kubernetes, e dei sistemi di repository e versionamento del codice (GitLab). - Esperienza o conoscenza delle metodologie DevSecOps/SecDevOps e dei principi di sicurezza delle pipeline di sviluppo e delle API. - Conoscenze in ambito IAM, sistemi di autenticazione e autorizzazione, certificati digitali e protocolli OAuth, OpenID Connect e SAML. - Conoscenza delle principali linee guida e best practice di sicurezza applicativa, inclusi OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10 e ASVS. - Conoscenze di base della sicurezza dei sistemi Linux e dei fondamenti di system e network security. - Esperienza nell'utilizzo di SonarQube o di strumenti SAST e DAST costituiranno elemento preferenziale - Conoscenza di ambienti cloud e architetture ibride. Completano il profilo proattività, orientamento al risultato, capacità organizzativa, attitudine al lavoro di squadra, flessibilità e approccio positivo alla risoluzione dei problemi. For FERRERO ARDENNES, a global leader in the confectionery industry, we are recruiting: MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS FOR FERRERO - BELGIUM At Ferrero's ARLON site you will find: Highly automated production lines and latest-generation Industry 4.0 technologies A solid, structured and merit-based organization that values strategic maintenance skills An international environment with many colleagues who have relocated from Italy and from all over the world What you will do The selected candidate will join the maintenance team (about 90 people) and will be responsible for routine, extraordinary, preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance on automated systems within the Arlon production site. Requirements Strong technical/mechanical background Fault diagnosis skills Experience in preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance in the mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic fields Ability to replace components and manage format changeovers Ability to identify tolerances and dimensions, and to read/interpret mechanical and pneumatic drawings A strong motivation to relocate and to build a long-term professional and personal project abroad will complete the profile. Offer Gross annual salary between €45,000 and €60,000 Company-provided accommodation for the first two months Relocation allowance of €8,000 gross Electronic meal vouchers with a nominal value of €10 per working day, with €8.91 paid by the company and €1.09 paid by the employee 13.92 monthly payments Belgian Collective Labour Agreement CCT118 Job grade: skilled maintenance worker Supplementary health insurance (DKV) for the employee, spouse/partner and dependent children up to 25 years old Electronic gift voucher worth €40 net The client company will also cover the costs of a French language course. Candidates will be guided and supported throughout the entire selection process by dedicated staff; travel expenses related to the selection process will be covered by the company. Workplace: Arlon - Belgium Working hours: Monday to Sunday, continuous cycle on three shifts. You can view our dedicated Ferrero Belgium campaign at: https://www.gigroup.it/lavoro/aziende-che-assumono/ferrero/ Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Per azienda nostra cliente, siamo alla ricerca di un/una: Temporary HR Manager La risorsa verrà inserita con un mandato di 12/18 mesi, con l'obiettivo di garantire la continuità operativa della funzione HR, costruirne l'impianto organizzativo e accompagnare la crescita di una figura junior interna. La posizione rappresenta un'opportunità sfidante per professionisti HR con forte seniority, abituati a operare sia sul presidio operativo sia sulla strutturazione di processi, strumenti e priorità HR in contesti aziendali in evoluzione. Responsabilità principali La risorsa prenderà progressivamente in carico le principali attività HR, assicurando presidio, tempestività e supporto a Direzione e dipendenti, tra cui: assunzioni, variazioni contrattuali e cessazioni predisposizione di lettere di assunzione, aumenti, variazioni di livello e orario gestione disciplinare gestione di assenze, malattie, ferie e infortuni gestione delle comunicazioni aziendali e dei canali interni supporto su sistemi HR e presenze controllo bollature e gestione trasferte visite mediche, protocollo sanitario e mansionari documentazione relativa a smart working e stage aggiornamento job description recruiting, gestione CV e predisposizione proposte di assunzione gestione di distacchi esteri, welfare e benefit coordinamento documentale HR, PEC e archivio interfaccia con provider payroll e Confindustria supporto alla Direzione nella gestione delle tematiche relative al personale Parallelamente alla gestione operativa, il/la Temporary HR Manager lavorerà a stretto contatto con la Direzione per strutturare e far evolvere la funzione HR. Le principali aree di intervento includono: definizione di priorità HR coerenti con gli obiettivi aziendali supporto alla pianificazione delle risorse e analisi del costo del personale identificazione e retention delle persone chiave analisi dei fabbisogni formativi e costruzione di piani di sviluppo revisione di politiche retributive, sistemi premianti e benefit miglioramento del clima interno e della comunicazione aziendale ascolto delle esigenze dei dipendenti e rafforzamento della cultura organizzativa mappatura, razionalizzazione e formalizzazione dei principali processi HR introduzione di KPI e strumenti di reporting a supporto della Direzione La risorsa avrà inoltre la responsabilità di formare e accompagnare una figura junior interna, trasferendo competenze, metodo e approccio operativo. Profilo ideale: esperienza consolidata in ruoli di HR Manager capacità di presidiare sia attività operative sia progettualità organizzative autonomia, pragmatismo e forte senso di responsabilità esperienza nella costruzione o riorganizzazione di processi HR ottime capacità relazionali e di interlocuzione con Direzione e popolazione aziendale attitudine al trasferimento di competenze e alla crescita di risorse junior Sede: Non è previsto smartworking. Residenza/domicilio preferibilmente tra Torino e Cuneo. Durata incarico: 12/18 mesi Offerta: circa 60k + 10% MBO Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei D.Lgs. n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016 al seguente indirizzo: https://it.wyser-search.com/privacy-policy/ #LI-GS2

title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
description: Grafton LifeScience* is a dedicated team focused on enhancing the experiences, skills, and potential of candidates in Sales & Marketing, Clinical Research, Regulatory, and Operations within the Pharmaceutical and Medical sectors. We also specialize in roles related to customer support in the health-impacting distribution field (Pharmacies and Parapharmacies).We are a team of passionate professionals working to guide our candidates towards roles and corporate environments that best match their skills and expectations. In partnership with an integrated CDMO with around 60 locations worldwide, specializing in integrated sterile liquid and lyophilized product development and commercial manufacturing, we offer an opportunity for QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst Summary: As a QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst, you will join our collaborative PDS team, working cross-functionally in a GMP/GLP-regulated environment and contributing to the development and delivery of advanced products and technologies that help address global challenges in healthcare and environmental protection. Job Responsibilities: - The primary focus of this role will be the review and verification of analytical activities and documentation generated by the QC PDS laboratory, ensuring accuracy, completeness, data integrity, and compliance with applicable procedures and GMP/GLP requirements. - Review of analytical testing and documentation related to product release, stability studies, analytical method validation and transfer activities, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), using standard analytical techniques and instrumentation such as HPLC, UV-Vis, FT-IR, and Pharmacopoeial methods. - You will also receive appropriate laboratory training to maintain the capability to operate as a QC PDS Laboratory Analyst. - When required, you may provide hands-on support to routine laboratory activities and analytical testing. We offer an environment that values performance, quality, and innovation, providing the resources and opportunities to develop your expertise and grow your career while contributing to our mission of enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Skills: - Experience in a GMP Quality Control lab. - Familiarity with techniques including HPLC, UV-Vis, FT-IR, and compendial tests (pH, osmolality, container content, appearance). - Ability to work to critical timelines. - Effective interpersonal skills and attention to detail. - Strong documentation and analytical review capabilities. Education/Experience: - Degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Chemistry (CTF) or a related scientific field preferred. - Experience in reviewing QC data and documentation in a GMP-regulated environment. Contract Offer: 12 months Fixed-term agency contract. CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico, livello D1. Working time weekly: Monday to Friday Place of work: Monza Grafton LifeScience is a specialization of Gi Group Spa authorized to operate by the Ministry of Labor and Social Policies (Authorization No. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). description: Description des tâches:About the team & role:We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Today, we are entering an ambitious new chapter as part of the Robinhood family. The Risk team's mission is to safeguard Robinhood's operations by providing robust second-line oversight of technology and cyber risk. Our team values rigorous analysis, open communication, and proactive risk management! You will also help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities. This is an exciting opportunity to report directly to the Head of Risk & Authorized Manager and drive the safety of our Luxembourg operations!In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, support regulatory alignment, and help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities.This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. procedures, in alignment with Robinhood group standards and Bitstamp's jurisdictional regulatory requirements.Provide 2LOD oversight and monitoring across key technology and security initiatives and business-as-usual operations, including the review of and identification of issues, and ongoing review of risk metrics and indicators.Carry out risk assessments for new products and for existing systems, processes, and technology arrangements.Act in a 2LOD capacity collaborating with the IT and Security organizations, including close partnership with CISO and other relevant stakeholders.Enhance the risk appetite framework and KRIs for ICT risks, perform independent reviews, and provide independent challenge to 1LOD.Report findings, risk themes, and regular updates through established governance cadences and management bodies.Promote ICT risk awareness and help strengthen risk culture across the organization.Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.What you bring:8+ years of experience in cyber, technology, or ICT risk, with a strong understanding of second line oversight, control effectiveness, and independent challenge.Experience in a highly regulated environment, ideally in financial services, including interaction with regulatory expectations and governance processes.Strong understanding of ICT, cyber, and operational risks specific to cryptocurrency and digital asset businesses, including exchange and custody models, third-party dependencies, technology resilience, and heightened regulatory expectations.Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.Experience across technology risk, control assurance, incident response, and internal control environments; technology audit experience is a strong plus.Ability to assess complex technology and security risks, provide practical challenge to first-line teams, and influence outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.Experience in business continuity, identity and access management, secure software development.Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are strongly preferred; ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or similar certifications are a plus.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively across functions.What we offer:Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs.Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.If our mission energizes you and you're ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. title: Assistant Professor in Economics for Global-Local Analysis on Sustainable Devel.(m/f)
description: Assistant Professor in Economics for Global-Local Analysis on Sustainable Development(Valid from 22/10/2026 to 08/04/2027) Language: English (UK)Location Esch-sur-AlzetteCountry: Luxembourg Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental SystemsJob Number: UOL08556Contract Type: Professorial - PermanentSchedule Type: Full TimeWork Hours 40.0 Hours per WeekExpected Start Date: 01/05/2027 Job Level: MonolevelJob (internal): Assistant ProfessorExpertise: ProfessorsRole Type: Open PositionFunctions: Associate / Assistant ProfessorAbout usThe University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.The Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems strives to grow into an internationally recognised research hub for a sustainable and equitable world. Our goal is to help societies to transition to environmentally friendly and just conditions. At the core is the recognition that global environmental disruptions such as climate change, biodiversity loss, and resource depletion are closely linked with societal systems. To address these complex issues, we take a systemic approach and study the interconnectedness of human activities and the environment. Our mission is to develop sustainable, socially just, and environmentally friendly solutions by bridging disciplines and fostering collaboration between researchers, policymakers, and society. Your roleThe successful candidate will establish and lead internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems. A distinctive ambition of the professorship is to develop a multi-scale global–local–global perspective on sustainability by investigating how local decisions by producers, consumers and other actors are shaped by global markets, trade, technology, climate and policy – and how their aggregate effects feedback to landscapes, ecosystems and societies.Consequently, the candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Dr. Ralf Seppelt, Director the Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental System (LCSES), Email: ralf.seppelt@uni.lu. Your profileThe successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build and lead a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.The ideal candidate will have:• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 5 years postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding• Experience engaging with policymakers, NGOs, and other stakeholders to translate research into real-world impact• A demonstrated commitment to mentoring and fostering the next generation of researchers• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systemsLanguage requirements:The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. As a Senior Supply Chain Expert, you independently own the complete, end-to-end supply chain for a portfolio of complex brands at a Pan-European level - from their long-term, three-year plan through to day-to-day availability, inventory health and profitability. You act as a trusted consultant, balancing service, cost and profitability across the full supply chain, and you set and own the success metrics you work on daily, ensuring every brand's experience demonstrates our customer obsession.You work at project and program level and handle difficult, ambiguous situations with limited direction. You exercise high judgment, drive timely decisions, and align and unblock stakeholders across the brand, operations, finance and internal teams to get solutions live and adopted.- Profitability, buying & inventory health (Analysis & action): Keep the brand's supply chain healthy and profitable day to day - availability, stock positioning, lead times, cost to serve and margin. You identify where the biggest opportunities sit, define and deliver solutions that program teams adopt and scale across the organisation, and influence the direction and priorities of the wider team. You design the metrics we are measured by, challenge whether they capture the outcomes that matter, and set the standard - eliminating broken processes and establishing the mechanisms others build on.A day in the lifeThis role requires managing long-term strategy and day-to-day priorities at the same time, and judging which needs your attention first. title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: Allround Fitness Trainer / Instructeur
description: Ben jij de veelzijdige duizendpoot die zich overal op de sportvloer thuis voelt? Van een pittige Small Group Personal Training en functionele circuittraining tot een verdiepende Pilates- of Yogales: jij schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende trainingsvormen.Bij Personal Sports Brummen staan kleinschaligheid en persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Wij zoeken een gedreven allrounder die onze uiteenlopende lessen met energie, oog voor kwaliteit en enthousiasme kan verzorgen of overnemen.Over onze organisatiePersonal Sports Brummen is geen standaard sportschool. Wij zijn een professionele en betrokken studio waar alles draait om kwaliteit en persoonlijke begeleiding. Bij ons staan kleinschaligheid, biomechanische techniek en oprechte aandacht centraal. We hebben een hecht en gemotiveerd ledenbestand opgebouwd dat bewust kiest voor deskundigheid en een veilige trainingsomgeving. Binnen ons team heerst een informele, energieke en collegiale sfeer waarin ieders eigen initiatief en creativiteit enorm worden gewaardeerd.Over de vacatureWij zoeken een veelzijdige duizendpoot die zich overal op de sportvloer thuis voelt. In deze gevarieerde rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het zelfstandig verzorgen en overnemen van uiteenlopende lessen. Je begeleidt dynamische Small Group Personal Trainingen en functionele circuittrainingen, maar kunt net zo gemakkelijk een verdiepende pilates of yogales geven. Het is een flexibele functie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om jouw favoriete lesvormen vorm te geven en je eigen stempel op de trainingen te drukken.De uitdagingen van het werkGeen enkele dag en geen enkele groep is hier hetzelfde en dat vraagt om een echte allrounder. Jouw grootste uitdaging is het moeiteloos schakelen tussen totaal verschillende trainingsvormen en doelgroepen. Het ene uur coach je sporters op hoge intensiteit tijdens een circuittraining en het andere uur breng je rust en focus in een pilatesles. Daarnaast trainen bij ons deelnemers van alle niveaus tegelijkertijd. Het is aan jou de taak om de training ter plekke live te schalen en aan te passen aan de individuele belastbaarheid van elke deelnemer. Je zorgt dat iedereen op zijn eigen niveau maximaal wordt uitgedaagd, met altijd scherp oog voor de juiste houding, techniek en ademhaling. Je bouwt snel een band op en zorgt dat iedereen zich gezien voelt.

title: Docent Pilates / Pilates Instructeur

Kom gerust eens een kop koffie drinken en sfeer proeven!Stuur je motivatie en ervaring naar psbbrummen@gmail.com of app/bel direct naar 0630923552. We kijken uit naar je bericht!

Put your expertise to work in advancing scientific excellence, outstanding education and innovation at the Department of Medical Biology at Amsterdam UMC. As Head of the Department of Medical Biology, you will lead a dynamic and internationally visible department comprising more than 100 staff, including visiting researchers. With both the core facility and wet labs/dissection halls, the department is uniquely positioned to deliver high-quality teaching in microscopy, flow and dissection. You bring sound management, including effective management of the human capital, and you strike a balance between timely decision-making and delegation. title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career. Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

title: Verzorgende IG bij de Mins in Maastricht
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Envide in Maastricht - West een verzorgende IG.

Wil jij als Verzorgende IG werken op een locatie waar je echt kunt meebouwen aan de zorg van morgen? Bij woonzorgcentrum De Mins draag je niet alleen bij aan goede, persoonsgerichte zorg, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een locatie die volop in beweging is. De Mins groeit mee met de veranderende zorgvraag en ontwikkelt zich steeds meer richting psychogeriatrische zorg (PG). Dat betekent meer ruimte voor vakmanschap, samenwerking en jouw professionele inbreng.

Als verzorgende IG speel je een belangrijke rol in het dagelijks leven van onze bewoners. Je biedt zorg, begeleiding en ondersteuning en hebt oog voor wat iemand nodig heeft om zich prettig, veilig en gezien te voelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het uitvoeren van verzorgende en verpleegtechnische handelingen volgens het zorgleefplan.
  • Het observeren van veranderingen in de gezondheid en het welzijn van bewoners en hierop adequaat handelen.
  • Het samenwerken met collega's, behandelaren, familieleden en andere betrokkenen om de best mogelijke zorg te bieden.
  • Daarnaast denk je actief mee over verbeteringen binnen de zorgverlening en draag je bij aan een prettige woon- en leefomgeving. Omdat De Mins volop in ontwikkeling is, krijg je de kans om actief mee te bouwen aan de zorg van morgen. Je denkt mee over nieuwe werkwijzen, levert een bijdrage aan kwaliteitsverbetering en werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines. Zo maak je niet alleen het verschil voor bewoners, maar ook voor de verdere ontwikkeling van de locatie.

Jij bent een betrokken zorgprofessional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en bewoners ondersteunt om zoveel mogelijk hun eigen leven te blijven leiden.

Daarnaast:

  • Ben je in het bezit van een diploma verzorgende IG niveau 3.
  • Heb je affiniteit met ouderenzorg en persoonsgerichte zorgverlening.
  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar voor verschillende diensten.

Je werkt zelfstandig waar mogelijk, zoekt de samenwerking op waar nodig en draagt graag bij aan een positieve werksfeer binnen het team.

  • Werk jij graag met kinderen en haal je voldoening uit hun groei en ontwikkeling?
  • Vind je het fijn om samen te spelen, creatief bezig te zijn, buiten op ontdekking te gaan en voor te lezen?
  • Wil jij kinderen elke dag een veilige, warme en stimulerende omgeving bieden? Dan leren wij je graag kennen.
  • Bij MIK & Spelenderwijs begeleiden we kinderen van 0 tot 13 jaar in hun ontwikkeling, elk op hun eigen tempo.
  • Samen bekijken we welke werking het best bij jou past: kinderdagverblijf (0–4 jaar), peuteropvang (2 – 4 jaar) of buitenschoolse opvang (BSO) (4 – 13 jaar), én op welke locatie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Samen met kinderen spelen, ontdekken en creëren: knutselen, bouwen, muziek maken en buiten spelen.
  • Kinderen stimuleren in hun emotionele, sociale en cognitieve ontwikkeling.
  • Zorgen voor een veilige, vertrouwde en positieve leefomgeving.
  • Observeren, luisteren en inspelen op wat elk kind nodig heeft.
  • In gesprek gaan met ouders over de ontwikkeling van hun kind.
  • Samenwerken met collega’s, onderwijs en partners in de buurt.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Je hebt een relevant diploma kinderzorg / kinderbegeleider. Ook Belgische diploma’s komen in aanmerking.
  • Je hebt een warm hart voor kinderen en werkt graag met verschillende leeftijden.
  • Je bent creatief, enthousiast en positief ingesteld.
  • Je communiceert vlot met kinderen, ouders en collega’s.
  • Je bent flexibel en kan inspelen op de noden van elk kind.

Taalvereisten Nederlands

Kinderopvang (0–4 jaar): Nederlands niveau 3F

Buitenschoolse opvang (BSO): Nederlands niveau 2F

Sommige opleidingen voldoen hier automatisch aan. Indien nodig kan je een aanvullende cursus of taaltoets volgen — wij denken hierin actief met je mee.

Buitenlandse (incl. Belgische) diploma’s worden beoordeeld via DUO (NL). Omdat België een EU-lidstaat is, kun je in Nederland werken met je Belgische diploma — maar je moet het eerst laten erkennen. Dit heet een erkenning van beroepskwalificatie voor de functie “beroepskracht kinderopvang” (dagopvang, buitenschoolse opvang, gastouderopvang) bij DUO (NL). De procedure duurt gemiddeld ongeveer 3 weken. Erkenning of melding is gratis. Wij begeleiden je stap voor stap door het volledige traject.

  • Starttijden medewerkers: tussen 7.30 en 9.00 uur
  • Eindtijden: tussen 17.00 en 18.30 uur

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Preventief onderhoud optimaliseren
  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt een slimme onderhoudsstrategie om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken.
  • Storingen analyseren en oplossen
  • Je spoort technische problemen op binnen elektrotechniek, mechatronica en besturingstechniek, en zorgt voor duurzame oplossingen.
  • Continu verbeteren en innoveren
  • Je signaleert kansen voor automatisering en optimalisatie en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen.
  • Samenwerken met externe partners
  • Je schakelt met leveranciers en machinebouwers en bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en afspraken.
  • Zorgen voor een veilige werkomgeving
  • Je draagt actief bij aan een veilige en efficiënte werkplek voor jezelf en je collega’s.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een praktische en oplossingsgerichte techneut met een passie voor innovatie. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met een hands-on mentaliteit.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • HBO/Professionele bachelor werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek of Besturingstechniek
  • Brede technische kennis en interesse in zowel hardware als software
  • Affiniteit met automatisering, robotica en moderne productietechnologie
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding
  • De drive om eigenaarschap te nemen en continu te verbeteren

title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career. Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered
