title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

title: Experienced in salmon filleting or food production? We want to hear from you!
description:
Logent is looking for skilled seafood production workers for assignments in the Oslo region. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience from fish processing plants, salmon filleting and industrial seafood production.

Are you currently working in the seafood industry in Western Norway or Northern Norway and interested in a new opportunity? We offer assignments in the Oslo region, with the possibility of longer-term work for candidates willing to relocate. No higher Norwegian language skills required – English is sufficient.

We Are Looking For Candidates With Experience In
  • Industrial salmon filleting and trimming
  • Fish processing and seafood production
  • Preparing and handling fresh fish on production lines
  • Packing, sorting and quality control in seafood processing facilities
  • Working with industrial seafood production equipment

Relevant experience from a fish processing plant or seafood factory is essential. We are primarily looking for candidates who know the production environment and can contribute from day one.

Experience from restaurants og hotel environments does not meet the requirements for these positions.

Your Responsibilities
  • Depending on your experience and department, your tasks may include:
  • Filleting and trimming salmon and other seafood
  • Processing and handling fish on industrial production lines
  • Packing, sorting and inspecting finished products
  • Maintaining high standards of quality, hygiene and food safety
  • Following HACCP procedures and production routines
  • Keeping workstations and production areas clean and organised
  • Internal logistics, packing and palleting salmon
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary and working conditions
  • Flexible start up, this year og early next year. 
  • Modern seafood production facilities
  • Training and onboarding
  • Possibility of extended or long-term assignments for candidates relocating to the Oslo region who fits most criterias.
  • An international working environment
  • Free parking
  • Working hours: 06:00–14:00 or 11:00–19:00.
Who Should Apply?

You should:

  • Have at least 6–12 months of relevant experience from industrial seafood production, preferably salmon filleting, altnerativley poultry or meat.
  • Be comfortable working with fresh fish in a chilled production environment
  • Be able to work efficiently while maintaining high quality and hygiene standards
  • Be willing to work in the Oslo region
  • Speak English; Norwegian language at high level is not required, but an advantage with basic norwegian. 
  • If you have experience with electric pallet truck, it is a plus, and T1 certificate. 

Candidates currently living in Western Norway or Northern Norway are encouraged to apply, especially if they have experience from established seafood processing plants.

Recruitment Process

We review applications continuously and contact relevant candidates for interviews at our office or per Teams 

Please upload your CV and clearly describe your experience with salmon filleting, trimming or industrial seafood processing.

description:

About the Role

Ready to engineer reliable HVAC solutions for offshore oil and gas projects?

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Engineer to join an offshore modification and maintenance project in Stavanger. You will contribute to technical design, quality assurance, and multidisciplinary coordination, ensuring deliverables meet project requirements and applicable standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and quality-assure HVAC engineering deliverables.

  • Perform capacity calculations and technical assessments of HVAC systems.

  • Coordinate HVAC interfaces with clients, suppliers, and other engineering disciplines.

  • Contribute to installation planning, testing, and design reviews.

  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, regulations, and technical standards.

  • Review 3D models, technical drawings, and supplier documentation.

  • Recommend design improvements and cost-effective solutions.

  • Maintain engineering documentation and ensure design changes are incorporated.

  • Ensure deliverables meet project quality requirements and agreed deadlines.

  • Support engineering planning, progress monitoring, and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, or a related field.

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant HVAC design experience.

  • Experience with offshore modification projects, preferably in the North Sea oil and gas industry.

  • Good understanding of relevant HVAC standards and applicable regulations.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Valid offshore safety course or relevant offshore certification, as required for the assignment.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with MIPS, Navisworks, and/or E3D.

  • Experience with 2D/3D drawings and modelling.

  • Experience with technical documentation and preparation of installation packages.

title: Researcher Position in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
description:
The Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital, offers a full-time, two-year Researcher position in the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham.

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

The research group has a strong scientific and technical background in wireless communications, machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as radio frequency engineering and electronics. It collaborates closely with physician-scientists at the Intervention Centre. The Centre is internationally recognized for its scientific excellence and unique position in the field, promoting interdisciplinary research and development. You will work in a diverse and intellectually stimulating environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and scientific excellence in the development of future ICT-based healthcare solutions.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Work Tasks

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

  • Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
  • Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
  • Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
  • Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
  • Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.

Responsibilities

  • Lead research on learning-based, urgency-aware network control and distributed learning that adapts to network state and clinical priority.
  • Collaborate with the PhD fellow and master’s students.
  • Publish in leading networking venues and contribute to project management and new proposals.
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Required Qualifications

  • A PhD in computer networking, communications or computer science with a clear networking focus.
  • Publications on networking topics and demonstrated experience developing or applying machine-learning methods to networking problems.
  • Experience with network simulation, emulation or testbeds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent reinforcement learning, graph learning or federated learning.
  • Experience supervising students or contributing to research proposals.

Language Requirements

  • Very good written and spoken English.

Personal Qualities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
  • A high level of professionalism and work ethic.

We Offer

  • A full-time, two-year Researcher position. Salary according to the applicable salary scale and qualifications. Researcher salary range to be confirmed by HR but will be within 600 000 - 650 000 kr per annum.
  • Research collaboration with Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, and with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
  • A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
  • Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
  • An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
  • Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
  • Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.

Your application

  • Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position. Identify:
  • Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
  • Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
  • The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.

Supporting documents

  • A CV with a list of publications
  • Transcripts for your bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
  • Copies of your diplomas.
  • Up to three relevant publications. Briefly explain their relevance to the position and your contribution in the cover letter.
  • Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
  • Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.

Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter.

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. I vakre og historiske omgivelser fra 1600-tallet har Bærums Verk etablert seg som et unikt handelssted med over 40 butikker, håndverkere, verksteder, gallerier og spisesteder. title: Sales Representative (UK Market)
description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

 

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

 

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

 

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

 

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

 

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

 

Excited about this role?

We’d love to hear from you. Please apply via our career portal with your CV and cover letter.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Work location: Oslo, Norway (Hybrid)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

title: PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to pursue a doctoral degree and explore how mobile networks can work together to keep critical services running when facing failures or congestion?

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks. As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in business, administration, higher education and research.

The position is fully funded and will run for 4 years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline, and the workplace will be in Trondheim.

About the project

Mobile networks increasingly support critical services in emergency response, industry, transport, and maritime operations. Access to several networks can improve resilience, but sustaining a service requires more than restoring connectivity. Independently operated networks must coordinate resources and priorities while managing dependencies and commitments to existing users. They may also depend on shared infrastructure or capacity leased from one another, limiting the resilience gained from access to multiple operators. Norway’s plans for a new emergency network (Nødnett) over commercial mobile infrastructure illustrate the relevance of these broader challenges.

As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how mobile networks can cooperate to maintain critical services during failures, congestion, and recovery. Your research will address networks that retain their own operational policies and exchange limited information about capacity and internal state, developing insights applicable across public and private networks. A specific focus will be on the networked systems mechanisms, data paths, and open interfaces needed to support resilient service continuity in multi-operator mobile network systems, addressing research questions such as:

  • What information must networks exchange to make effective admission and resource-allocation decisions without requiring full visibility into each other’s infrastructure?
  • How can service priorities and resource policies be coordinated across heterogeneous networks, including during congestion and large bursts of registration requests?
  • How can network selection, traffic steering, and recovery mechanisms maintain application continuity while avoiding repeated switching and overload cascades?
  • How do shared infrastructure, leased capacity, and dependencies between operators affect failure propagation and the resilience gained from alternative network access?

With the Beyond 5G lab at the department, the project will emphasize experimental systems research: you will have the opportunity to conduct your research in both commercial and open-source mobile network deployments and test your ideas under realistic conditions. To explore conditions beyond the scale of the physical deployments, methods including simulation and analytical modeling can be a complementary building block.

Duties of the position
  • Complete doctoral education and obtain a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the Networking research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching in courses related to networking
  • Other career-enhancing work

Some changes to your work duties may occur after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Information Security and Communication Technology, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
    • You must have a relevant master's degree in communication networks, wireless and mobile communications, information security and distributed systems, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
    • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and preferably within August 2027.
    • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
    • If you are in your master’s program, integrated PhD could be an option. Your MSc grades after your fourth year need to be completed with a grade B or better, in addition the IE-faculty require that your bachelor degree is completed with a grade C or better. Integrated PhD - Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - NTNU.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Practical experience with 5G radio access and core deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with communication networks including multi-vendor and softwarized environments.
  • Exposure to resilience and dependability topics in the context of communication networks as part of the master’s curriculum.
  • Teaching experience, preferably at master’s level.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are

  • Highly motivated by fundamental scientific research with practical relevance.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Able to work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them.
  • Eager to disseminate research results both locally as well as through publications and presentations at international conferences.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation, in terms of the qualifications specified in the advertisement.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to one year of career promotion work.

The successful candidate will be granted conditional admission to the relevant doctoral programme when employed in the PhD position. It is a prerequisite for continued employment that the requirements for full admission are met within three months, and that you continue to participate in the organized doctoral programme for the remainder of the employment period. For more information about the requirements for full admission, please see Section 6 of the PhD regulations. 

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The application and all required attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no before the deadline. The documents must be in Norwegian, another Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. If you are invited for an interview, you must present certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for bachelor's and master's degrees, including diploma supplement
  • CV filled out in Jobbnorge
  • Copy of master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages, written in English) including a brief problem formulation, research questions, methodological approach, and an initial progress plan for the project.
  • Short letter of motivation (max. 400 words / 1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Any relevant certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts of, your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution does not offer “diploma supplement”, you must attach information about the grading scale from the education institution. 

We further recommend that you enclose a statement about your education abroad from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir). Follow the link to their web site for more information about how to obtain such a statement: Apply for recognition of foreign higher education. See also NTNU’s web site for documentation requirements for education obtained outside Norway. 

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Stanislav Lange, e-mail: stanislav.lange@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Executive Officer HR Julie Lindland e-mail: julie.lindland@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 30.11.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology

Research is vital to the security of our society. We teach and conduct research in cyber security, information security, communications networks and networked services. Our areas of expertise include biometrics, cyber defence, cryptography, digital forensics, security in e-health and welfare technology, intelligent transportation systems and malware. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

title: Completion Engineer

title: Nestleder varehus Vinstra
description:
Gausdal Landhandleri søker en operativ, tydelig og samlende nestleder, som vil være med og utvikle varehusene våre og skape gode resultater sammen med folkene rundt seg. Som nestleder vil du jobbe tett sammen med varehusleder som har en delt lederrolle for Vinstra og Dombås. Rollen skal bidra til god gjennomføring av varehuskonseptet vårt, effektive arbeidsprosesser, riktig bemanning og en god kundeopplevelse.Dette er en rolle for deg som liker kombinasjonen av ledelse, mennesker, salg og praktisk varehusdrift, og som ønsker å ta et større ansvar og være med på å utvikle både deg selv og organisasjonen. Erfaring fra byggevare, handel, salg eller tilsvarende virksomhet er en fordel.

For den rette kandidaten mener vi dette kan være et naturlig neste steg for deg som ønsker å utvikle deg videre som leder og ta større ansvar over tid.

Dette er deg

  • Det viktigste for oss er at du liker å ta ansvar, får med deg folk og evner å skape resultater sammen med andre.Du er synlig og til stede i hverdagen, trives tett på både kunder og medarbeidere og har forståelse for hva som skal til for å drive et godt varehus.

    Vi ser etter deg som:

    *har interesse for ledelse, salg og varehusdrift*er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit*motiverer og utvikler menneskene rundt deg*er strukturert og følger opp det som blir besluttet*har god forretningsforståelse og kommersiell teft*er løsningsorientert og trives med en variert og operativ arbeidshverdag*kan stå stødig når det er mye som skjer*ønsker å utvikle deg videre som leder

Dette er jobben

  • Som nestleder skal du:

    *være en operativ sparringspartner for varehusleder*bidra til sikker, effektiv og lønnsom drift*bidra til at Gausdal Landhandleris varehuskonsept gjennomføres i praksis*følge opp medarbeidere, rutiner og arbeidsprosesser*bidra til gode og effektive bemanningsplaner*ha et tydelig fokus på salg, kunder og gode kundeopplevelser*bidra til god vareflyt, orden og gjennomføring av aktiviteter*følge opp HMS og andre sentrale driftsrutiner*kunne tre inn for varehusleder ved ferie, fravær og andre situasjoner hvor det er nødvendig

Dette er mulighetene

Hos Gausdal Landhandleri får du:

  • en sentral rolle i utviklingen av varehusene på Vinstra og Dombås
  • en operativ lederrolle hvor du får jobbe tett på både mennesker, kunder og butikk
  • mulighet til å utvikle deg videre innen ledelse, salg og varehusdrift
  • jobbe sammen med erfarne kolleger i Region Nord og resten av Gausdal Landhandleri
  • bli en del av en virksomhet med sterk lokal forankring, hvor nærhet til kunden står sentralt
Vi tilbyr
  • I Gausdal Landhandleri står kompetansebygging og sosiale aktiviteter høyt i kurs og veien til beslutninger er kort. Vi har et arbeidsmiljø hvor det god takhøyde, en uformell tone og hvor de ansatte kan være med å påvirke egen utvikling og sin egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige arbeidsvilkår, full lønn under sykdom og foreldrepermisjon, god pensjonsordning og en gunstig ordning for personalkjøp.
  • Ønske om snarlig tiltredelse
  • Søknader vurderes fortløpende
KontaktinformasjonAne Renathe Olstad, Varehusleder Vinstra og Dombås, +47 91864177, anol@gaus.no ArbeidsstedLomoveien 6 2640 Vinstra Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Gausdal Landhandleri AS Referansenr.: 5203284740 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 15.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gausdal Landhandleri er en familieeid, tradisjonsrik byggevarekjede med røtter tilbake til 1938. Vi selger og distribuerer byggevarer til privat- og bedriftsmarkedet. Vi har i dag 26 byggevarehus i Innlandet, Akershus og Buskerud. Selskapet har en sterk bedriftskultur, preget av fagkunnskap, pålitelighet og fokus på kundeservice.  Vår visjon er å gi våre kunder «En enklere hverdag, en bedre byggeopplevelse».

title: Innkjøpskonsulent – kundeoppfølging, forhandling og salg
description:
Motiveres du av kundekontakt, gode løsninger og konkrete resultater? På vegne av vår kunde søker vi nå flere innkjøpskonsulenter til et selskap i sterk vekst innen bruktbilmarkedet.

 

Som innkjøpskonsulent får du ansvar for hele kundereisen, fra første samtale til eventuell signering av avtale. Du vil jobbe med behovskartlegging, pristilbud, forhandlinger og oppfølging, samtidig som du bidrar til en trygg og positiv kundeopplevelse.

 

 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Følge opp kunder gjennom hele prosessen.
  • Presentere pristilbud og forhandle frem gode avtaler.
  • Gjennomføre digitale videovisninger av biler.
  • Følge opp kontrakter og sikre fremdrift i egne prosesser.
  • Samarbeide med interne avdelinger og bidra til forbedring av rutiner.

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som er serviceinnstilt, strukturert og trives med å jobbe mot konkrete mål. Du er god på kommunikasjon, liker å skape relasjoner og motiveres av salg og gode kundeopplevelser.

Erfaring fra salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Du får grundig opplæring, og relevant erfaring og personlige egenskaper vektlegges.

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fastlønn og attraktiv provisjonsordning.
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging.
  • Et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.
  • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter i et selskap i vekst.

Praktisk informasjon

  • Arbeidssted: Kløfta, med planlagt flytting til Oslo i løpet av 2027.
  • Arbeidstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 09.00–17.00. Lørdagsarbeid kan forekomme ved behov.
  • Oppstart: Etter avtale.
  • Søknadsfrist: Snarest – aktuelle kandidater vurderes fortløpende.

 

Er dette neste steg for deg?

 

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker en rolle der du kan kombinere kundekontakt, relasjonsbygging og resultatorientert arbeid. Hvis du liker å finne gode løsninger, skape tillit og bidra til at kundene får en positiv opplevelse, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Send oss din søknad og CV. Legg gjerne ved vitnemål fra videregående skole og/eller høyere utdanning.

 

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos Dreamwork skaper vi drømmeteam for ledere og drømmejobber for folk. Vi kobler kompetanse, innsikt og menneskelige kvaliteter for å bygge sterke team og varige resultater. Vårt mål er enkelt – å finne den riktige personen til den riktige jobben, hver gang.

title: Helgestillinger ved GY91 – sykepleier og helsefagarbeidere
description:
Vil du ha en helgestilling hvor du får brukt fagkompetansen din, bygge relasjoner og gi tjenester med høy grad av kontinuitet?

Ved GY91, hjemmetjeneste på Haugenstua, søker vi nå:

  • 1 sykepleier i 21,48 % fast stilling med arbeid annenhver helg
  • 2 helsefagarbeidere i 14,8 % faste stillinger med arbeid hver tredje helg

GY91 har en organisering som skiller seg fra tradisjonell hjemmesykepleie. Vi har base i en kommunal boligblokk på Haugenstua med 55 leiligheter og gir tjenester utelukkende til beboerne i bygget. Omtrent 30 beboere mottar hjemmesykepleie, flere med behov for oppfølging flere ganger daglig.

Siden både base og brukere er samlet i samme bygg, bruker vi minimalt med tid på transport og kan i stedet prioritere faglig oppfølging, tilgjengelighet og gode relasjoner. Dette gir gode muligheter for kontinuitet og for å bli godt kjent med brukerne du følger opp.

I samme bygg ligger også Dagtilbud Haugenstua GY91, noe som bidrar til et levende og tverrfaglig miljø.

Gyldig politiattest jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 må fremvises før ansettelse. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

Sykepleier: 

  • Utføre selvstendige sykepleiefaglige vurderinger og tiltak
  • Ivareta funksjonen som ansvarlig sykepleier på aktuelle vakter
  • Kartlegge, observere og vurdere brukernes helsetilstand
  • Samarbeide med brukere, pårørende, fastleger og øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Følge opp legemiddelbehandling og gjennomføre sykepleiefaglige prosedyrer
  • Veilede kolleger, elever og studenter ved behov
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetssikring og kontinuerlig forbedring av tjenesten

Helsefagarbeider

  • Utføre nødvendig helsehjelp i tråd med vedtak, tiltaksplaner og gjeldende rutiner
  • Observere, dokumentere og følge opp endringer i brukernes helsetilstand
  • Håndtere legemidler i henhold til kompetanse, fullmakter og gjeldende prosedyrer
  • Dokumentere og rapportere i Gerica
  • Samarbeide med brukere, pårørende og kolleger for å sikre helhetlige tjenester
  • Bidra til kontinuitet, trygghet og pasientsikkerhet i tjenesten
  • Benytte aktuelle velferdsteknologiske løsninger i oppfølgingen av brukerne
  • Bidra til et godt, inkluderende og faglig sterkt arbeidsmiljø
Kvalifikasjoner

Sykepleierstillingen:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie, eldreomsorg eller kommunehelsetjenesten er ønskelig
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Evne til å gjøre selvstendige sykepleiefaglige vurderinger
  • Kjennskap til Gerica er en fordel

Helsefagarbeiderstillingene:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie, eldreomsorg eller tilsvarende arbeid er ønskelig
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Kjennskap til Gerica er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er faglig engasjert og opptatt av kvalitet i tjenestene
  • Arbeider selvstendig og tar ansvar
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Er løsningsorientert og fleksibel
  • Møter brukere og kolleger med respekt og omtanke
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Faste helgestillinger i et faglig spennende arbeidsmiljø
  • Et arbeidssted med korte avstander og god oversikt
  • Mulighet til å følge brukerne over tid og skape gode relasjoner
  • Engasjerte og dyktige kolleger
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Rabatterte priser på SATS treningssenter
  • Lønn etter ansiennitet, i lønnsramme 26-09 for sykepleier og 10-08 for helsefagarbeider
  • Lønn, pensjons,- låne og forsikringsordninger etter gjeldende avtaleverk

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Stovner ligger nordøst i Oslo med grense til Romeriksregionen. Her er gode kommunikasjonsmuligheter med tog, T– bane og buss. Bydel Stovner er en IA virksomhet og er en arbeidsplass preget av mangfold og inkludering.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

title: Klinisk ernæringsfysiolog
description:
Friskliv og mestring søker engasjert og faglig sterk klinisk ernæringsfysiolog til vårt tverrfaglige team. Vi jobber for å gi innbyggere i Stavanger lett tilgjengelig, effektiv og kunnskapsbasert hjelp. Som klinisk ernæringsfysiolog ved Friskliv og mestring vil du ha et viktig bidrag i det ernæringsfaglige arbeidet i tjenesten, men også jobbe terapeutisk og helhetlig i møte med mennesker med et bredt spekter av helseutfordringer.  

Tjenesten har en salutogen og recovery-orientert tilnærming. Oppfølgingstilbudet i tjenesten består av et bredt spekter av ulike kurs og gruppetilbud, supplert med veiledet selvhjelp og individuell samtalebasert oppfølging. Stillingen passer for personer som ønsker å jobbe i et tverrfaglig team med en helhetlig tilnærming til helse. Teamet vårt består per i dag av psykolog, fysioterapeut, sykepleier, sosionom, klinisk ernæringsfysiolog, idrettspedagog og barnevernspedagog, samt fagkonsulenter med kompetanse innen psykoterapi og ernæring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

De vanligste arbeidsoppgavene vil være å:

  • Gjennomføre kartleggings- og vurderingssamtaler.
  • Gi strukturert oppfølging i form av individuelle samtaler. 
  • Bidra i utvikling, planlegging og gjennomføring av kurs- og gruppetilbud.
  • Bidra i tjenesteutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid.Du vil også kunne få andre oppgaver knyttet til tjenestens drift og utvikling.
 Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Krav:

  • Stillingen har krav om utdanning som klinisk ernæringsfysiolog med autorisasjon
  • Klinisk erfaring med å gi strukturert oppfølging til mennesker som ønsker å endre levevaner og kostholdsveiledning

Videre er det ønskelig med

  • Kurs eller videreutdanning innen kognitiv terapi, motiverende samtale og/eller annen relevant tilleggskompetanse.
  • Arbeidserfaring fra frisklivssentral eller lignende.
  • Erfaring med å yte helsehjelp i form av individuelle samtaler, kurs/grupper og veiledet selvhjelp.  

Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språknivå tilsvarende B1. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Møter mennesker med respekt, varme og tydelighet, og samarbeider godt med kolleger for å skape et faglig sterkt og inkluderende miljø.
  • Kommuniserer klart, empatisk og profesjonelt i møte med både pasienter og kolleger.
  • Bidrar aktivt i fagutvikling og ser muligheter for forbedring i både arbeidsmetoder og tjenestetilbud.
  • Liker variasjon og klarer å skifte fokus når behovene i tjenesten endrer seg.
  • Jobber strukturert og selvstendig i eget klinisk arbeid, samtidig som du liker og evner å samarbeide tett i et tverrfaglig team.
  • Har evne til å motivere og støtte mennesker i endringsprosesser med fokus på mestring og ressurser.

Personlig egenhet vil bli vektlagt. 

Fast stilling, 100% stilling

  • Et fagmiljø bestående av dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere med bred faglig kompetanse
  • Et sosialt, inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø 
  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Varierte og sammensatte oppgaver
  • Gode velferds- og pensjonsordninger 
  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariff 

 

For spørsmål om stillingene, ta kontakt med Emmeline Krogh Werner, telefon 90959180

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere. Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke.

Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion.

Offentlig søkerliste: 

Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

title: Miljøterapeut / Fengselsbetjent– Ungdomseining Vest Bjørgvin fengsel
description:
Om stillinga

Kriminalomsorgen region vest har etablert eit nasjonalt sonings- og varetektstilbod for mindreårige ved Bjørgvin fengsel. 

Bjørgvin fengsel Ungdomseining vest søkjar 3 fengselsbetjentar/miljøterapeuter til fast stilling snarast. 

Stillinga inneber turnusarbeid med arbeid kvar tredje helg.

Tilbodet byggjer på tett tverretatleg samarbeid med barnevern, psykisk helsevern, opplæringstenester og kommunale instansar. Målet er intensivt endringsarbeid slik at størst mogleg del av straffegjennomføringa kan skje utanfor fengsel.

Som tilsett ved Ungdomseining Vest arbeider du tett med unge innsette under 18 år. Du skal bidra til tryggleik, struktur og målretta progresjon arbeid. Rolla inneber både tryggleiksfaglege oppgåver og relasjonsarbeid.

Du vil vere samtalepartnar, kontaktbetjent, rollemodell og rettleiar. Arbeidet krev evne til tryggleikstenking, grensesetjing, konfliktløysing og motivasjonsarbeid.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • daglege oppgåver i forhold til unge innsette 
  • strukturet endringsarbeid etter miljøterapeutiske prinsipper 
  • andre rutinemessige oppgåver vere ein aktiv medspelar i utviklinga av det faglege og tryggleiksarbeidet ved avdeling 
  • motivera dei innsette 

Den som blir tilsett, må rekne med endringar i ansvars- og arbeidsområde.

Kvalifikasjonar

 

Du må ha for miljøterapeut stilling:

  • Bachelorutdanning frå høgskule/universitet (helse- og sosialfagleg retning er føretrekt)
  • Minimum eitt års erfaring frå miljøterapeutisk arbeid og/eller arbeid i fengsel
  • Erfaring frå institusjonsarbeid (vil bli vektlagt)
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne
  • God IKT-kompetanse
  • Førarkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskapar

Du må oppfylle dei fysiske funksjonskrava som gjeld for opptak ved KRUS. Det vil bli gjennomført fysiske funksjonstestar for miljøterapeuter som må beståast.  https://www.krus.no/fysisk-funksjonstest.521471.no.html

Du må ha for fengselsbetjent stilling:

  • Bestått fengselsbetjentutdanning frå Kriminalomsorgens høgskole og utdanningssenter KRUS 
  • God kunnskap og erfaring i bruk av IKT - system og verktøy 
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne 
  • Førarkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskapar

Det er ønskjeleg at du har

  • Fleksibilitet og tåler uføreseielegheit og har evner å prioritere i stressande situasjonar 
  • Erfaring frå arbeid med barn og unge
  • Fagleg interesse og engasjement for målgruppa
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner og evne til å skape relasjonar til innsette 
  • har evne til tryggleikstenking, grensesetjing, og å vere ein samtalepartnar og rollemodell for dei innsette 
  • har god evne til tverrfagleg samhandling 
  • har evne til å arbeide sjølvstendig og systematisk 
  • har evne til å ta ansvar og ta avgjerder, også i krevande situasjonar 
  • evne og vilje til å delta på aktivitetar med ungdom utanfor fengselet 

Personleg eignaheit vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Meiningsfulle arbeidsoppgåver i ein etat med eit viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Fagleg utfordrande og utviklande arbeid
  • Gode pensjons-, forsikrings- og låneordningar i Statens pensjonskasse
  • Trening i arbeidstida
  • Gratis parkering og ladepunkt for el-bil

Stillinga er lønt som 1201 miljøterapeut med årslønn frå kr 540 000 til 685 000, avhengig av kvalifikasjonar. Eller som fengselsbetjent 0264 med årslønn pålydande, kr 515 000 - 645 000 pr år.Gode tillegg for ubekvem arbeidstid. Det blir trekt 2 % innskot til Statens pensjonskasse.

Generell informasjon

Tilsette sine haldningar og verdiar skal vere i tråd med kriminalomsorga sitt verdisyn. 

Våre verdiar er: Openheit, tryggleik og nytenking.

Det må ikkje vere noko å utsetje på vandelen til den som blir tilsett. Dette må dokumenterast med ein uttømmande politiattest før tilsetjing.

Vi gjer merksam på at opplysningar om søkjarar kan bli offentleggjorde sjølv om søkjar har bede om å vere unnateke søkjarlista. Søkjar vil i så fall bli varsla om dette og gjeve høve til å trekkje søknaden.

Eit godt arbeidsmiljø er prega av mangfald, og vi oppmodar kvalifiserte søkjarar med ulik arbeids- og livserfaring til å søkje jobb hos oss. Kriminalomsorga arbeider for å realisere regjeringas inkluderingsdugnad om at 5% av alle nytilsetjingar i staten skal vere personar med nedsett funksjonsevne eller hòl i CV-en.

Vi gjer merksam på at dersom søkjarane oppgjev at dei har nedsett funksjonsevne eller «hòl i CV-en» kan opplysinga nyttast til registreringføremål.

Prøvetida er 6 månader.

Den som blir tilsett, må rette seg etter organisasjonsmessige eller andre endringar som blir bestemte om arbeidsområdet. Det går for tida føre seg ein utgreiingsprosess i kriminalomsorga som kan medføre ei organisasjonsendring.

Nærare opplysningar om stillinga får du ved å vende deg til fengselsinspektør Arne M. Hægland tlf. 55251284

For spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktast på 75 54 22 20.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kriminalomsorga sitt samfunnsoppdrag er å gjennomføre varetektsfengsling og straffereaksjonar på ein måte som er tillitvekkjande for samfunnet og som motverkar strafflagde handlingar. Målet vårt er at den domfelte etter soning skal

velje å leve eit kriminalitetsfritt liv. Kriminalomsorga består av Kriminalomsorgsdirektoratet (KDI), Høgskolen og utdanningssenteret for kriminalomsorga KRUS og fem regionar med cirka 60 lokale fengsel og friomsorgskontor.

title: Høgskoledirektør
description:
Vil du være med å lede og bidra i utviklingen av Høgskolen i Molde?

Høgskolen i Molde står i en spennende utviklingsfase og søker nå en strategisk og samlende høgskoledirektør. Vi er en vitenskapelig høyskole med sterke fagmiljøer og ambisjon om å oppnå universitetsstatus. Du skal bidra til å realisere vår strategi og sørge for at den administrative virksomheten fungerer godt hver dag. Sammen med rektor, styret og organisasjonen skal du gjøre prioriteringer som gir gode rammer for utdanning, forskning og høgskolens bidrag til regionen. 

Om rollen

Som høgskoledirektør er du øverste leder for den samlede administrative virksomheten. Du har et stort personalansvar og får en sentral rolle i å prioritere ressursene, utvikle administrasjonen og gi fagmiljøene gode rammer for utdanning og forskning.  Høgskolen har todelt ledelse, med valgt rektor som faglig leder og styreleder. Du rapporterer til styret og samarbeider tett med rektor om strategisk utvikling, virksomhetsstyring og organisasjonsutvikling.  

Høgskoledirektøren har det overordnede ansvaret for økonomi- og virksomhetsstyring, HR og personalforvaltning, administrative tjenester, risikostyring og internkontroll. Du følger opp styrets vedtak og arbeider for god ressursbruk og videreutvikling av organisasjonen innenfor våre økonomiske rammer. Du bistår rektoratet og holder rektor løpende informert om saker av betydning i administrasjonen. Stillingen legger også administrativt til rette for høgskolens universitetsambisjon.

Du har også et ansvar for å ivareta høgskolens interesser utad. Det innebærer dialog med studentene og kontakt med myndigheter, regionale samarbeidspartnere og andre aktører utenfor høgskolen. Du skal også ivareta gode samarbeidsrelasjoner med de tillitsvalgte og deres organisasjoner, inkludert et tett samarbeid med Studentsamskipnaden i Molde.

Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en tydelig og inkluderende leder som skaper tillit og får folk med seg. Du tenker strategisk og analytisk, kommuniserer klart og finner løsninger i komplekse saker. Du arbeider etterrettelig, involverer dem som blir berørt, og sørger for framdrift og resultater. Dette er en lederstilling hvor tillit, integritet og evnen til å bygge gode relasjoner står sterkt. Rollen krever at du kan håndtere ulike interesser i skjæringspunktet mellom fag, administrasjon og politiske føringer. Personlig egnethet vil derfor bli tillagt stor vekt i vurderingen av kandidater.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå, eller tilsvarende. Særlig omfattende og relevant ledererfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • Dokumentert ledererfaring på strategisk nivå og solid erfaring med økonomi- og virksomhetsstyring, organisasjonsutvikling og personalledelse.
  • Erfaring med risikostyring og internkontroll.
  • Svært god forståelse for offentlig forvaltning og styringsprosesser, inkludert partssamarbeid.
  • Erfaring fra universitets- og høgskolesektoren, eller annen offentlig virksomhet er en fordel. 
  • Svært god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk.
Vi tilbyr

Du får en bred topplederrolle ved en vitenskapelig høgskole med sterke fagmiljøer og engasjerte medarbeidere. Høgskolen i Molde har korte beslutningsveier og tett samarbeid mellom fagmiljøer, administrasjon og ledelse. Her får du nærhet til hele virksomheten og mulighet til å påvirke hvilke muligheter høgskolen skal satse på, innenfor rammene den har. Du får arbeide tett med rektor, ansatte og studenter i en sektor som er viktig for samfunnets behov for kunnskap og kompetanse.

Arbeidssted er Molde, med forventet tilstedeværelse i Kristiansund. Vi tilbyr lønn etter avtale og medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse. 

Interessert?

Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, etnisk bakgrunn eller hull i CV-en. 

Vi ønsker også å oppfordre til å ta tidlig kontakt med våre rådgivere i The Assessment Company for en uforpliktende og konfidensiell samtale om stillingen og virksomheten.  

Høgskolen i Molde er omfattet av reglene om offentlig søkerliste. I samsvar med offentleglova § 25 vil offentlig søkerliste foreligge etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg mot å stå på offentlig søkerliste, må det begrunnes. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Søkere vil i tilfelle bli informert før offentliggjøringen og vil ha mulighet til å trekke søknaden. 

Søknadsfrist: 22. november 2026.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskolen i Molde er en vitenskapelig høgskole med særlig styrke innen logistikk og et bredt utdanningstilbud innen helse- og sosialfag, økonomi, IT, juss, samfunnsvitenskap og Sport Management. Med om lag 3800 studenter og ca 330 ansatte er vi en sentral kunnskapsinstitusjon på Nordvestlandet. Høgskolen i Molde har virksomhet på to campus, Molde og Kristiansund. Vi arbeider målrettet for videre utvikling av institusjonen og styrking av vår posisjon som kunnskapsinstitusjon og en viktig aktør for samfunnsutvikling.
