title: Data Signing Service DevSecOps Engineer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team     About the Opportunity   Ericsson Product Public Key Infrastructure (EPPKI) is an in-house organization hosted within BA Networks (BNEW), providing security services to Ericsson products and services globally. Our portfolio includes Certificate Authority (CA) management, hardware credential enrollment, Software and Hardware Bill of Materials (SBOM and HBOM) report generation, Malware Scanning Services (MSS), and Data Signing Services (DSS). We are now looking for a Data Signing Service DevSecOps Engineer to join the EPPKI organization. In this role, you will work closely with our product and development units to ensure that our data signing services are secure, reliable, and scalable. You will contribute across the service lifecycle, from infrastructure and tooling to development, automation, testing, and operations, while having the opportunity to deepen your expertise in the technical areas you are most passionate about. If you are motivated by software development, cybersecurity, and automation, enjoy using modern technologies to improve productivity and efficiency, and thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment, this could be a great opportunity for you.   What you will do •    Develop and enhance service features, tools, and automation solutions•    Provide operational support, including system configuration and provisioning of signing flows•    Contribute to the secure design, development and operation of data signing services, applying security-by-design and DevSecOps principles•    Design test strategies and develop clear, maintainable automated test cases•    Act as a technical point of contact for users of the signing service•    Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve CI/CD flows•    Perform maintenance and lifecycle management of the service and its supporting infrastructure•    Drive continuous improvements across products, tools, automation, and processes•    Maintain clear, accurate and up-to-date technical and user documentation•    Collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders across product and development organizations   The skills you bring •    Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field, such as Computer Science, IT or Engineering•    Experience with Linux, preferably Red Hat, and scripting using Python and/or Bash•    Strong interest and competence in security and secure software/services•    Good programming skills, preferably in Java•    Experience with Git and modern software-development practices•    Experience with CI/CD platforms and deployment/configuration automation, such as Ansible•    Knowledge of software-testing principles and test automation•    Familiarity with test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, JCAT or similar•    Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills•    A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge•    Curiosity, initiative, and clear professional communication skills•    A minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience

title: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
description: Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)Third-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral projectA PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:     How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?    How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?    In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?    In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale. About the positionThe main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites. The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. Desirable experience    Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.    Experience working with fish.    Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.    Experience with independent writing.    Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.    Experience with analysis of large datasets.    Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.    Will contribute to a good working climate.    Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.    Driver’s licence.    Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work. About usAt the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:     An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues    Access to a broad international network of scientists    Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale    Good welfare benefits Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/ Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Scope100% LocationDrottningholm, Stockholm Start date2027-04-01, or upon agreement. Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time. Academic union representativeshttps://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. The team is responsible for optimizing process performance, supporting safe and stable operations, and driving continuous improvements across our hydrogen production and direct reduction plants.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very few silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Provide day-to-day process engineering support to ensure safe, stable, and efficient plant operations.    Monitor plant performance, troubleshoot process upsets, and lead root cause analyses to improve reliability and operational excellence.    Optimize process performance through process modelling, heat and mass balances, debottlenecking, and energy efficiency initiatives.    Support direct reduction operations during commissioning, start-ups, shutdowns, and operational changes.    Review and develop engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, SOPs, and process control strategies.    Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, and OEM partners to improve process performance and implement engineering solutions.    Drive continuous improvement projects, monitor production KPIs, and prepare technical reports to support data-driven decision-making.    Promote safe operations by supporting process safety activities, hydrogen safety standards, PTW/LOTO compliance, and technical training.What you'll bringYou're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking—and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we'd like to see that you bring:    A degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.    Solid process engineering experience from an operating, commercial-scale Direct Reduction plant.    Experience supporting commissioning, start-ups, process optimization, or operational improvements in an industrial setting.    A strong understanding of process engineering fundamentals, with the ability to analyse complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions.    Experience with hydrogen production is a plus. Curiosity about the hydrogen process and a willingness to learn are important.    Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Engineering, and external partners to achieve shared goals.    A proactive, structured, and safety-first approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

title: DCEO Engr 3
description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.Basic Qualifications- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience- 2+ years of relevant work experience- Strong English verbal and written communication skillsPreferred Qualifications- Experience in data center engineeringAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Backend Developer / Engineer - 20450
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Backend Developer / Engineer for a consulting assignment within a team responsible for release management of the organization’s primary applications. The mission is to enhance and streamline the release process through improved monitoring, automation, and quality assurance.The organization is transitioning from Jira to a new tool and needs to establish a separate database for release tracking. The consultant will analyze dependencies and automation flows between Jira projects and release tools, then design and implement an appropriate technical solution. A central part of the assignment is the continued development of an existing dashboard into a unified decision-support solution. It will provide clear performance and stability metrics, defined thresholds, and quality gates with approved, warning, and blocked status levels.The solution must guide release managers toward clear next steps and automatically create issues and send notifications when deviations occur, without negatively affecting release cadence. Initial support will cover the organization’s most important Android and iOS applications, with the possibility of future expansion.Key Responsibilities    Analyze dependencies, integrations, and automation flows between Jira projects and release management tools.    Design and implement a separate database and supporting technical solution for release tracking.    Enhance an existing dashboard into a consolidated decision-support tool for release stakeholders.    Implement metrics for application performance and stability, including thresholds and quality gates.    Provide actionable guidance for release managers based on approved, warning, and blocked status levels.    Automate issue creation and notifications when release metrics or quality indicators deviate from defined thresholds.    Develop end-to-end functionality across backend and frontend components.    Collaborate closely with release managers, data scientists, and release engineers to translate operational needs into usable technical solutions.    Ensure that delivered code is tested, maintainable, and thoroughly documented for ongoing support and development.    Work independently within large, established codebases and deliver useful results from the beginning of the assignment.Technical Stack & Requirements    Backend: Strong development expertise in Java and Python.    APIs and services: Experience designing services and developing REST or gRPC APIs.    Frontend: Practical experience with React and TypeScript.    Data-intensive interfaces: Experience building user-friendly internal tools and dashboards that process or present large data volumes.    Release tooling: Experience analyzing and automating workflows involving Jira and release management platforms.    Mobile delivery: Knowledge of release processes for Android and iOS applications is advantageous.    CI/CD: Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery tools is preferred.    Backstage: Previous experience developing Backstage plugins is advantageous.Qualifications & ExperienceA minimum of five years of software development experience is required, together with documented success delivering full-stack functionality from initial design through production-ready implementation. The consultant must be comfortable entering large, existing codebases, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and working independently with limited guidance. Strong product understanding is required, including the ability to translate ambiguous processes and stakeholder needs into simple, practical tools. The role also requires effective written and verbal communication and experience collaborating across multiple teams.

kaufmännischen Grundausbildung, einer Weiterbildung im HR\-Bereich und deiner Erfahrung in der Personal\- und Lohnadministration meisterst du deine Aufgaben kompetent und zuverlässig* Deine und Projekten ein### Das erwartet dich* Du übernimmst eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Aufgabe in einer bekannten und dynamischen Organisation* Du arbeitest in einem zweier\-Team bestehend aus der Team mit kollegialer und wertschätzender Arbeitsumgebung* Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten für eine bessere Work\-Life\-Balance* Du erlebst eine offene und transparente Kommunikationskultur### So kannst du dich bewerbenDann sende die vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in elektronischer Form an das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz Kanton Luzern, .![Verein Schweizerisches Embedded\-Computer von Syslogic dienen als Hardware\-Basis, um Trends von morgen Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Flache Hierarchien, langfristige Perspektiven und Mut, etwas zu bewegen – das zeichnet uns aus.  Ja, ich übernehme eine aktive und treibe die Trends von morgen voran. Ich bin ein Organisationstalent – verantwortungsbewusst, teamorientiert und begeisterungsfähig. ### Ich bringe mit* Ich verfüge über eine kauf­männische Ausbildung.* Ich habe ein gutes Verständnis für technische Produkte und Zusammenhänge.* Ich kommuniziere sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.### Ich packe an* Ich bin die Schnittstelle zwischen Verkauf, Produktionsplanung und unseren Kundinnen und Kunden.* Ich erstelle Angebote und verfolge diese bis zur Auftragserteilung.* Ich erfasse und überwache Aufträge im ERP\-System.* Ich arbeite eng mit den Key Account Managern zusammen und pflege das CRM.### Ich schätze* Die Möglichkeit, etwas zu bewegen und die Welt ein kleines Stück voranzubringen* Flexible Jahresarbeitszeit, Teilzeitmöglichkeiten und einen Tag Remote\-Office pro Woche* Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, die auf mich zugeschnitten ist* Du\-Kultur, kurze Entscheidungswege, familiäres Umfeld und ein Team, das zusammenhält* Langfristige Perspektiven und die Möglichkeit, mich weiterzuentwickeln.* Ungezwungene Firmenevents, die begeistern*Mehr zu unseren Benefits erfährst du am Vorstellungsgespräch.*### Ich bin neugierig!Meine berufliche und persönliche Herausforderung ist mir wichtiger als das perfekte Bewerbungs­dossier. description: DauerstelleStadtspital ZürichFür das Strategische Controlling im Departement Finanzen suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit.Aufgaben* In dieser spannenden Funktion innerhalb des Strategischen Controllings bist du Mitglied des Teams Planung und Steuerung.* Kernaufgabe dieser Abteilung ist die finanzielle Steuerung der Business Einheiten sowie die Sicherstellung der Kosten\- und Ergebnistransparenz und die Erarbeitung von Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der finanziellen Situation.* Du unterstützt die operativen Führungskräfte in den medizinischen Bereichen als Sparringpartner. Weiter berätst du die Kliniken in der Strategischen Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du eng mit dem Medizincontrolling und der Betriebsbuchhaltung zusammen.* Du erstellst aussagekräftige Analysen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnungen und arbeitest an der jährlichen Budgeterstellung mit.* Du nimmst eine aktive Rolle ein bei der Weiterentwicklung der Controlling\-Instrumente und Reporting\-Tools.* Du arbeitest mit und/oder leitest Projekte bei betriebswirtschaftlichen und fachübergreifenden Themen (Einführung Centerrechnung, Ambulante Tarife, etc.).Profil* Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung* Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling* Analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen* Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Darstellung und Vermittlung komplexer Zusammenhänge* Ziel\- und Ergebnisorientierung* Initiative Persönlichkeit mit Durchsetzungsvermögen und hoher Eigenverantwortung* Du bist es gewohnt stufengerecht zu kommunizieren und verstehst dich als Teamplayer* Hohe IT\-Affinität und Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP sowie BI Systemen runden dein Profil ab* Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen und branchenspezifisches Wissen der Daten\- und Wertströme nach REKOLE sind von VorteilWir bietenWir bieten dir mehr als nur einen Job! Unsere Stadtspital\-Welt ist geprägt von einer offenen Du\-Kultur, einem unkomplizierten, persönlichen Miteinander und der nötigen Prise Humor im Alltag. Als Team aus über 120 Berufsgruppen setzen wir uns täglich auf ganz unterschiedliche Weise für das Wohl unserer Patient\*innen ein. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen einschliesslich Homeoffice und ausgezeichneten Sozialleistungen der Stadt Zürich.Über unsDas Stadtspital Zürich zählt mit über 36'000 stationären und rund 455'000 ambulanten Patient\*innen pro Jahr zu den Top 10 der Schweizer Spitäler. Als modernes Zentrumsspital an mehreren Standorten in der Stadt Zürich bieten wir die gesamte Bandbreite der medizinischen Grundversorgung, inklusive 24\-Stunden\-Notfall und Intensivmedizin an. Unsere 4'500 Mitarbeitenden setzen sich täglich mit viel Engagement und Herzblut für eine exzellente Patientenversorgung ein.Interessiert?Für weitere Informationen steht dir Kim Aggeler, Teamleiterin Planung und Steuerung, Telefon , gerne zur Verfügung.Referenz\-Nr.: 52022j4id10460889jm j4it1044jm j4iy26jm

title: Solution Engineer D365 Business Central
description: Aproda AG ist der führende Dynamics 365 Integrator für Schweizer KMUs. Teamspirit, deine Weiterentwicklung sowie eine Vertrauenskultur stehen bei uns an erster Stelle. Damit uns das gelingt, setzen wir das Vertrauen in unsere 160 Mitarbeitenden und in unsere Partnerschaft mit Microsoft.Bei dir laufen die technischen Fäden zusammen.Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse zusammenspielen, technische Entscheidungen mitprägen und gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Projektteams Lösungen entwickeln, die langfristig funktionieren? Dann könnte diese Rolle ziemlich gut zu dir passen.Als Solution Engineer D365 Business Central verbindest du Softwareentwicklung, Architektur und technische Beratung und gestaltest unsere Business\-Central\-Lösungen aktiv mit.  **Du bewegst*** Du entwickelst und erweiterst Lösungen rund um Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central und bringst dabei deine technische Erfahrung gezielt ein* Gemeinsam mit Kund:innen, Projektteams und internen Fachbereichen erarbeitest du Software\-Architekturen, technische Lösungsdesigns und Abnahmekriterien* Du begleitest Upgrades, Hotfixes, Tests, Deployments und Inbetriebnahmen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen auch technisch sauber laufen* Du unterstützt unseren Support und entwickelst das Aproda\-Lösungsportfolio technisch weiter* Als Technical Consultant bringst du dich auch in der Beratung ein und übernimmst in ausgewählten Fachgebieten Verantwortung in Teilprojekten* Themen wie EDI, MDE, DMS, Printing oder Labeling bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dein Know\-how weiter auszubauen und eigene Schwerpunkte zu setzen**Deine Skills*** Du hast einen HF\-/FH\-Abschluss in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik oder bringst eine vergleichbare Ausbildung und Erfahrung mit* Du kennst Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central seit mindestens drei Jahren und verfügst über mehrjährige Entwicklungserfahrung im Microsoft\-Umfeld* Geschäftsprozesse, Software\-Architektur, Customizing und Schnittstellen sind für dich keine Fremdwörter* Cloud, IT\-Services und angrenzende Microsoft\-Technologien interessieren dich auch über dein direktes Aufgabengebiet hinaus* Du gehst analytisch an Herausforderungen heran, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und behältst gleichzeitig die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden im Blick* Wissen behältst du nicht für dich: Du arbeitest gerne im Team, tauschst dich aus und möchtest dich fachlich weiterentwickeln* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch**Deine Perspektive*** Aproda steht für ein unkompliziertes und wertschätzendes Miteinander, eine gelebte Open\-Door\-Kultur und ein vertrauensvolles Hands\-On\-Mindset* Bei uns kannst du arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst bzw. wo unsere Kunden und Mitarbeitenden sind: Wir bieten dir ein modernes, flexibles und autonomes Arbeitsumfeld mit Remote Work\-Option* Du bleibst bei uns nie stehen. Lass uns gemeinsam ein Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem du aufgehen und dein Potenzial voll entfalten kannst* In deiner herausfordernden Funktion erzielst du Wirkung und trägst aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg bei* Kundenseitig erwartet dich ein spannendes und vielseitiges Portfolio mit namhaften Brands im KMU\-Bereich* In unseren mindestens gleich wichtigen «Nebendisziplinen» findet sich in erster Linie ganz viel Spass! Weiter sind mindestens 4 Teamevents pro Jahr, individuelle Weiterbildungen, gratis Parkplatz und Kaffee, attraktive Benefits, neueste Hardware, 6 Wochen Ferien und ein grandioser Team\-Spirit hoffentlich bald auch dein Happy (Work) Place. title: Information Security Director
description: Ref 2587951 \| Date: 28 Oct 2026![Michael Page]( )Our client is seeking an experienced and hands\-on Information Security Director to define, implement, and continuously enhance its enterprise security program. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role combines strategic leadership with operational execution across cybersecurity governance, risk management, cloud security, identity management, compliance, and incident response.Information Security DirectorOur client is an innovative and fast\-growing biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformational therapies for patients with ophthalmic and neuro\-ophthalmic diseases. Operating internationally in a highly regulated industry, the organization leverages a modern, cloud\-first technology environment and is committed to investing in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and operational excellence to support its long\-term growth ambitions.**Description**Our client is seeking an experienced and hands\-on cybersecurity leader to define, implement, and continuously enhance its enterprise security program. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role combines strategic leadership with operational execution across cybersecurity governance, risk management, cloud security, identity management, compliance, and incident response. The successful candidate will play a critical role in protecting the organization's digital assets, supporting business growth, and ensuring a robust security posture within a highly regulated environment.* Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the company's cybersecurity strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.* Lead cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance programs, including policy development, risk assessments, internal controls, and audit readiness.* Own the security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and collaboration platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments.* Oversee identity and access management (IAM) processes, ensuring secure user provisioning, privileged access controls, and authentication standards.* Direct security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation activities in collaboration with internal and external partners.* Manage cybersecurity third\-party service providers, including MSSPs, security consultants, penetration testing firms, and technology vendors.* Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber resilience initiatives to ensure operational preparedness and rapid recovery capabilities.* Establish and monitor cybersecurity KPIs and metrics, providing regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations to leadership.* Drive data protection, privacy, and information security initiatives, ensuring appropriate safeguards for critical business and research data.* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-related risks and controls, to ensure secure adoption and governance.* Promote a strong cybersecurity culture through awareness programs, employee education, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.**Profile*** Bachelor's or master's degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity and IT, including at least 3\-5 years in a leadership or management role.* Proven track record of developing and executing enterprise cybersecurity programs within complex and highly regulated environments.* Strong expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security operations, incident response, and vulnerability management.* Hands\-on experience securing Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, endpoint protection platforms, and cloud\-based infrastructures.* Deep understanding of identity and access management, 0\-trust principles, network security, and modern cybersecurity architectures.* Experience leading security audits, regulatory assessments, and compliance initiatives aligned with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, or similar standards.* Previous experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical and cyber risk topics to executive leadership, board members, and non\-technical stakeholders.* Strong project management and vendor management capabilities, with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.* Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, or Microsoft Security certifications are highly valued.* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decision\-making across all levels of the organization.**Job Offer*** Attractive package and environment* Flexibility with 2 days of Home Office per week* A unique opportunity to build, lead, and shape a growing cybersecurity function within an innovative and international organization.* Ownership of high\-impact cybersecurity, compliance, and digital transformation initiatives.* A collaborative and dynamic work environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, cloud environments, and evolving cybersecurity challenges.* Competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and attractive long\-term career growth opportunities.jpida216b3fjm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

title: Security Analyst / Architect
description: Ref 2588110 \| Date: 29 Oct 2026![Bechtle Suisse SA]( )Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d)Be your best with Bechtle-------------------------Avec plus de 16 000 employés, nous sommes l'une des entreprises informatiques les plus prospères et les leaders du marché dans notre secteur.  L'association de la vente directe de produits informatiques et d'une gamme complète de prestations de services proposée par les différentes sociétés de services informatiques fait de nous un partenaire informatique fort et porteur d'avenir (« zukunftsstark ») pour les entreprises moyennes, les grands groupes et le secteur public. Nous sommes chez nous dans toute l'Europe et toujours près de chez vous.  Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d)====================================Be your best with bechtle-------------------------Pour le compte de notre client basé à Genève, nous recherchons un·e Security Analyst / Architect (f/m/d) pour une mission de 6 mois, chargé d'assurer les opérations de sécurité, de garantir la continuité des services critiques et d'accompagner la sécurisation des déploiements GenAI et du Product Lifecycle Framework.#### **Ta mission*** Piloter la gestion des vulnérabilités de bout en bout : scans mensuels, analyse et priorisation des CVE selon CISA KEV et EPSS, suivi des correctifs et reporting de conformité, tout en assurant la migration de Rapid7 InsightVM vers CrowdStrike Vulnerability Management.* Exploiter et faire évoluer l'environnement CrowdStrike : migration du tenant européen, retrait de Cortex XDR, intégration des sources de logs dans Next\-Gen SIEM, développement de règles de détection et traitement de niveau 2 des alertes et incidents.* Assurer la sécurité réseau et le cycle de vie des certificats en appliquant les hardening releases Fortinet et Palo Alto, en révisant les règles de pare\-feu et en pilotant les activités TLS/PKI, notamment inventaire, renouvellements, DCV et audit de la PKI interne.* Piloter les remédiations issues des tests d'intrusion et Red Team, prendre en charge les sujets de sécurité en backlog, notamment les guardrails AWS et SCP, et devenir autonome sous trois mois sur les services de sécurité critiques afin d'en assurer la continuité.* Sécuriser les déploiements GenAI et leur intégration au cycle de vie produit en réalisant les threat models, en définissant les guardrails avant mise en production et en intégrant les contrôles de sécurité aux différentes étapes du Product Lifecycle Framework.Ton profil----------* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience pratique en security engineering ou security operations, dont au moins 2 ans dans un environnement d'entreprise complexe, avec une forte autonomie sur des services de sécurité opérationnels.* Expérience confirmée de la gestion des vulnérabilités de bout en bout : scanning, priorisation selon CISA KEV et EPSS, suivi des correctifs et reporting. Une expérience de migration de plateforme de vulnerability management est appréciée.* Bonne maîtrise de CrowdStrike Falcon, EDR et Next\-Gen SIEM, ou d'un environnement équivalent, avec une expérience de l'intégration de sources de logs, de la création de détections et du traitement d'incidents.* Solides connaissances des environnements Fortinet et/ou Palo Alto ainsi que de TLS, PKI et de la gestion des certificats. Bonnes bases en sécurité AWS : IAM, SCP, Security Groups et lecture de findings CSPM avec Wiz ou une solution similaire.* Expérience concrète de la sécurisation d'au moins un déploiement GenAI ou LLM en production : threat modelling, prompt injection, risques de fuite de données, excessive agency et conception de guardrails.* Expérience d'un environnement produit ou SDLC intégrant des contrôles de sécurité aux différentes étapes du cycle de vie, avec de très bonnes capacités de documentation et de coordination transverse ; Anglais et Français courant requis.#### **Notre proposition*** Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif* Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle* Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenirNuméro d'emploi : LVYML388  Kevin Brosse \| \|  Bechtle Suisse SA-----------------Bechtle Suisse SA dispose de compétences certifiées dans les domaines stratégiques : Infrastructure IT, Virtualisation, Information Management, Managed Services, Skills Management, Data\& Analytics, Printing Solutions et E\-Commerce. Grâce à ces compétences et à de solides et durables partenariats avec les principaux acteurs du marché, nous proposons une gamme modulaire et parfaitement cohérente de produits et de services pour couvrir l'ensemble des besoins de nos clients. Notre proximité, notre vision globale de l'infrastructure et de la gestion de projets font de nous un acteur incontournable du marché. Nos 1000 collaborateurs motivés sont nos meilleurs atouts pour assurer rapidité, flexibilité et expertise.jpidd5a354fjm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
==========================================

HEKS beschäftigt über 1500 fest angestellte Mitarbeiter:innen. An 24 Standorten in der Schweiz und weltweit in 35 Ländern ist HEKS mit 290 Programmen und Projekten im Umfang von rund 144 Millionen Franken tätig. Im Jahr 2024 erreichte HEKS rund 16 Millionen Menschen mit seiner Arbeit.  

HEKS verfolgt die Vision einer gerechten Welt, in welcher die Würde aller Menschen respektiert wird, Frieden herrscht und die natürlichen Lebensgrundlagen bewahrt werden. Ziel ist eine Transformation auf sozialer, wirtschaftlicher und politischer Ebene. HEKS leistet einen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Lebensumstände von Menschen in der Schweiz und weltweit, fordert ihre Rechte ein und sensibilisiert und mobilisiert zu diesem Zweck.  


Wir verstärken unser Finanzteam in Zürich und suchen nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
------------------------------------------

### Das sind deine Hauptaufgaben:

* Du trägst im Tagesgeschäft die Verantwortung für das Führen des Hauptbuches nach den Vorgaben von Swiss GAAP FER und dem schweizerischen Obligationenrecht, insbesondere\- Bearbeitung und Verbuchung von Abgrenzungen, Bewertungsfragen, Rückstellungen und weiteren komplexen Einzelsachverhalten\- Sicherstellen der korrekten und vollständigen Abbildung aller Nebenbücher (Kreditoren, Spendenbuchhaltung, Anlagebuchhaltung etc.)\- Führen der Anlagebuchhaltung
* Du wirkst proaktiv an Weiterentwicklungs\- und Digitalisierungsprojekten innerhalb der Finanzbuchhaltung mit
* Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung der periodischen MWST\-Abrechnungen in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld (Pauschalsteuersatzmethode, internationaler Kontext) sowie für die Beurteilung und Deklaration der Bezugssteuer und die Abrechnung und Rückforderung der Verrechnungssteuer
* Du wirkst als Fachspezialist mit im Konsolidierungs\-, Kreditoren\- und Ertragserfassungsprozess, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kolleg:innen im In\- und Ausland
* Du unterstützt das Team bei Fragen rund um die Abwicklung von Legaten, bei der Planung und Durchführung der externen Revision, sowie beim Sicherstellen eines effektiven internen Kontrollsystems


### Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

* Eine kaufmännische Grundbildung sowie ein abgeschlossener oder laufender Fachausweis im Finanz\- und Rechnungswesen oder eine vergleichbare Zusatzausbildung sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion
* Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
* Vertiefte MWST\-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Business Central sowie Kenntnisse in der Buchhalterischen Behandlung von Fremdwährungsthemen sind von Vorteil
* Eine engagierte, dynamische und strukturierte Persönlichkeit mit Zahlenflair
* Affinität für Prozessautomatisierung und digitale Tools


### Das darfst du von uns erwarten:

* Eine sinnstiftende, vielseitige und spannende Tätigkeit in einer renommierten NGO mit nationaler und internationaler Ausrichtung
* Hohe Selbständigkeit und die Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Grosse Flexibilität bezüglich Präsenzzeiten und Arbeitsort
* Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen


**Möchtest du das HEKS\-Team ergänzen?**

Dann freuen wir uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung via unserem [Bewerbungstool.](<>) Bitte hab Verständnis, dass E\-Mail oder Briefbewerbungen nicht verarbeitet werden können.

**Eine gelebte Diversität \- Inklusion ist uns ein Anliegen:**

Wir begrüssen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Alter oder sexueller Orientierung.

Collaborateur / technicien SAV \- Machines à café \& Matériel de fête
=========================================================================

**Collaborateur / Technicien SAV – Machines à café \& Matériel de fête**

**Lieu de travail :** Chavannes\-les\-Forts  
**Taux d'activité :** 100%  
**Entrée en fonction :** de suite ou dès le

**À propos de nous :**  
Nano Coffee Sàrl est un acteur clé de la région dans la fourniture, la location et l'entretien de machines à café professionnelles et de matériel événementiel. Pour renforcer notre équipe technique et garantir un service d'excellence à nos clients (entreprises, fêtes), nous recherchons un collaborateur SAV polyvalent et passionné.

**Vos missions principales :**

**Suivi clients \& relevés mensuels :** Effectuer les visites mensuelles auprès de nos entreprises partenaires pour réaliser les relevés de compteurs des machines à café et évaluer l’état général des fourniture.

**Maintenance et réparation :** Assurer le diagnostic, l'entretien préventif et le dépannage (en atelier et chez les clients) de machines à café de différentes marques ainsi que du matériel de fête (friteuses, grills, etc.)

**Préparation et logistique :** Contrôler et tester le matériel de fête avant chaque mise à disposition et au retour des locations pour garantir leur parfait fonctionnement

**Service client \& urgences :** Conseiller les clients sur l'utilisation du matériel et intervenir rapidement en cas de panne, notamment lors d'événements durant la saison haute

**Gestion administrative :** Rédiger les rapports d'intervention

 

**Votre profil :**

Formation technique (CFC d'électromécanicien, électricien, mécanicien sur appareils ou formation jugée équivalente)

Expérience confirmée dans le dépannage (une expérience sur les machines à café est un sérieux atout)

Permis de conduire de catégorie B obligatoire

Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation

Flexibilité dans les horaires (disponibilité pour des piquets le week\-end en période de fêtes)

Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit).

 

**Ce que nous offrons :**

Une activité variée au sein d’une petite entreprise familiale

Travail dans des locaux entièrement rénovés

Un véhicule de service équipé

Autonomie dans le travail

 

**Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil ?**  
Envoyez\-nous votre dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail) par mail ou contactez\-nous au 079 654 32 70 pour plus d'informations.

Nous répondrons uniquement aux dossiers correspondant au profil demandé.

des absences de l'adjoint. * Achats et logistique : contribution à l'approvisionnement et à la gestion des médicaments. * Encadrement : accompagnement des internes en pharmacie, notamment dans leurs title: Principal Scientist I Crop Protection Research Chemistry (m/f/d)
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Group, a global leader in agricultural technology and innovation, employs 60,000 people across more than 100 countries to transform agriculture through tailor-made solutions for farmers, society, and our planet. Our diverse portfolio encompasses seeds, crop protection, nutrition products, agronomic solutions, and digital services, all designed to help farmers produce healthy food, feed, fiber, and fuel while conserving natural resources and protecting the environment. Our mission is to address critical challenges such as climate change and food security through sustainable practices and cutting-edge solutions, while safeguarding the planet's resources. At our R&D Center in Stein AG, Switzerland, the Crop Protection Research (CPR) Chemistry team is at the forefront of innovation. Here, you will design and synthesize novel products that promote crop health and contribute to the evolution of agricultural practices. Your work will play a crucial role in advancing our mission to ensure global food security through sustainable solutions. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.Job DescriptionYour responsibilities:Lead and contribute to research projects, applying state-of-the-art research programs to identify and optimize novel bioactive ingredients interacting with relevant biological targets for crop protection.Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams with local and global experts to drive research programs to develop sustainable crop protection solutions.Advance project delivery through scientific investigations, applying expertise in molecular design, physical organic chemistry, and synthetic problem-solving.Formulate and experimentally test data-driven hypotheses, deconvolute complex structure–activity relationships (SAR) by integrating empirical and predictive data to drive Multi-Parameter Optimization toward key project milestonesDrive scientific advancement and technological innovation in modern agrochemical discovery by proactively developing and applying cutting-edge skills and technologies, while fostering a culture of continuous learning, creativity, and strategic foresight.Embed digital, data, and AI capabilities into project workflows to accelerate discovery and improve predictive decision-making.QualificationsWhat we are looking for:Scientific Foundation: Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry or Medicinal Chemistry; postdoctoral or industry experience is an advantage.Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in synthetic organic chemistry; direct application to bioactive small molecule research is strongly preferred and highly valued.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated success in steering multidisciplinary scientific teams, driving consensus, and delivering project milestones across complex matrix environments.Innovation Mindset: Self-driven and curious, with a proactive approach to adopting emerging technologies and advancing project goals.Communication: Excellent command of English, adept at conveying complex scientific findings to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.What you bring to our team:Technical curiosity for life sciences, including small molecules and new chemical modalities.Enthusiasm for applying and championing cutting-edge science and digital technologies.Creativity, curiosity, and strong decision-making skills with a commitment to continuous learning.Excellent organizational and time management abilitiesCollaborative mindset with strong communication skills to build productive relationships within Syngenta and with international collaboratorsDedication to welcoming different perspectives and fostering a diverse, inclusive and open work environmentAdditional informationWe provide access to state-of-the-art research facilities and technologies, enabling you to apply and expand your expertise in agrochemical design principles, synthetic organic chemistry, and active ingredient optimization.We cultivate a superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce, where new ideas are always welcome. We embrace flexible work arrangements and foster work-life balance.We foster a digitally enhanced research environment throughout our R&D processes. This offers you the opportunity to develop digital data analysis skills, positioning you at the forefront of drug discovery.We invest in your professional growth and development through a multidisciplinary training program tailored to foster a rewarding career in crop protection.We are part of a strong regional Science hub, offering you the opportunity to interact with a rich community of scientists in life sciences, further enhancing your professional network and knowledge exchange.You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)Are you interested? Please send your complete application with CV in English, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered.
